node.description:
Elizabeth Liones is the third adoptive princess of the Kingdom of Liones Originally an alleged survivor of Danafor's destruction, Elizabeth was adopted and raised by the king [Bartra Liones](https://anilist.co/character/131565/Bartra-Liones). After the Holy Knights rebel, she sets on journey to find Seven Deadly Sins, becoming a waitress for [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas-)' tavern Boar Hat.

~!She is 107th and current incarnation of the Goddess Elizabeth, and the lover of Meliodas, captain of the Seven Deadly Sins. She is the deuteragonist of the series.!~

She is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. She has the mark of the boars sin of gluttony. She was regarded as the greatest mage in Britannia and is the master of [Vivian](https://anilist.co/character/131564) as well as a teacher of [King Arthur of Camelot](https://anilist.co/character/122210). She came to the aid of the sins in their battle against [Hendirkson](https://anilist.co/character/86679) but had to leave to tend to the King. She has not officially rejoined the sins but said she would as soon as she was finished with her other business.

__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") (Human size), 23 - 24 cm (0'9") (doll)

He is shown to be completely clueless and unaware of others' feelings, not understanding the meaning of friendship. He often states things factually, not understanding how what he says can upset people. He decides to assist [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth) on her journey, not because of a desire for justice, but because he felt obligated as a member of the Seven Deadly Sins.

Since Gowther doesn't understand emotions, he goes to great length to understand them. For example, observing [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) and [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban)'s friendship.

One of the holy knights of the Britannia kingdom. He is a Diamond-ranked Holy Knight.

name.native: アーサー・ペンドラゴン

node.description:
Named the king of Camelot after pulling a sword from the stone that hundreds of holy knights could not.

Arthur is a polite, young man who is still adjusting to his role as king. He takes his responsibilities very seriously, but usually undertakes them with a smile and has a very warm, and happy-go-lucky demeanor.

He marched toward the kingdom of Liones with an army of illusions created by [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin) in hopes of meeting with the king; however, he was confronted by [Hendricksen](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) who tried to kill him before [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) came to his aide.

Jericho is an apprentice Holy Knight who served under the Weird Fangs. She was stationed at the Baste Dungeon, where the Deadly Sin, Ban was imprisoned. She is young woman of slim build, with light hair that is swept over the left side of her face and tied into a ponytail at the back. She wears a black coat over her armor, adorned with a cross on the left side and larger cross covering the back. Underneath her armor are similarly fashioned black clothes. Metal gauntlets cover her arms, while metal greaves and sabatons cover her legs and feet.   Jericho is a proud and serious individual. She is stern in her command over the guards of Baste Dungeon and overconfident in her abilities, appearing arrogant at times, which led to her humiliation by Ban.

Lancelot is the son of [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban) and [Elaine](https://anilist.co/character/86681/Elaine). He is also a Holy Knight of Liones, and one of the Four Knights of the Apocalypse.
Melascula is a warrior of the Demon Clan, serving directly under the Demon King as the Faith of the Ten Commandments.

Geera is a Holy Knight who left herself in a near-death state to have access to the Capital of the Dead and kill the Deadly Sins who had gone there. She is a young female with a slim build. She has long black hair and her eyes are depicted as if they are closed.

Hauser is a Holy Knight, a colleague and partner of [Gilthunder](https://anilist.co/character/74285/Gilthunder), and a subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, [Dreyfus](https://anilist.co/character/86677/Dreyfus). He wears a set of Holy Knight armor and has short light-colored curled up hair. Hauser demonstrates a lot of self confidence and is very optimistic, which is the complete opposite of Gilthunder's personality; he is also shown to be somewhat naive and stupid.
Percival is the son of Ironside and grandson of Balgis, and is the main protagonist of the sequel, Four Knights of the Apocalypse.

Hendricksen is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. He wears a set of and covers it with a robe on top. He has short light-colored hair and also a goatee. Hendricksen is a serious man, who, like Dreyfus, appears to be willing to capture the king and enslave the citizens to prepare for the Holy War. However, he also seems to be plotting something.

name.native: トリスタン・リオネス

node.description: Tristan is the son of Meliodas and Elizabeth Liones. He is also one of the Four Knights of the Apocalypse and the current prince of the Kingdom of Liones.

Galand is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen).

Slader was kidnapped and raised as a child by savages who held no regard for his worth as a human. After being freed by the king of Liones he pledged loyalty and resolved to hunt down any who wronged the kingdom.

He is a member of Dawn Roar who holds a rivalry against Gowther of the Seven Deadly Sins.

Nasiens is a mysterious person Percival meets at Echo Gorge. Nasiens is a young person with short light brown hair and yellow eyes. Nasiens has a great interest in plants, wanting to be a herbalist like his adoptive grandfather Ordo was. He gets very excited when making new discoveries, liking to experiment with everything around him.

Dreyfus is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. His attire consists of a standard set of a Holy Knight's armor that has a spike on each shoulder. He has long black hair that reaches up to his shoulder, with a short beard.

Gawain is one of the Four Knights of the Apocalypse. Gawain is a tall and well-built young woman, with dark-blue short hair and green eyes. Gawain wears a full suit of white armor with gold trimming and a face-concealing helmet.

Anghalhad is a girl Percival meets at Sistana. Anghalhad is a young girl with long, fluffed pale cyan hair and turquoise eyes. She wears a white frilly dress with a magenta blouse along with socks and heels. She carries a dotted umbrella which hides a rapier in the center.

The eleventh king of Liones and father of Elizabeth.

He was held captive after the Seven Deadly Sins were framed for killing the great holy knight Zaratras.

Donny is a member of the Katz Street Troupe. Donny is a tall teenager, with long red hair and is a bit burly. Donny wears a white button-down shirt, which leaves part of his chest uncovered, and black pants with some kind of pockets on the sides, and a pair of light-colored boots. Donny used to train as a Holy Knight apprentice under his uncle Howzer alongside his friend Edlin. However, seeing that he lacked the strength to become a Holy Knight, Donny dropped out of training and joined the Katz Street Troupe alongside Katz and Elva.

Varghese is the grandfather of Percival and the father of Ironside. Sixteen years ago, he was a Holy Knight of Camelot before he abandoned the kingdom following the betrayal of his son. Since then, he has raised his grandson alone on God's Finger until the day came when Ironside returned and killed him before attempting to do the same to Percival.

Isolde is a Holy Knight of Liones, serving under the Tristan Platoon of prince Tristan Liones.

Isolde takes her duty as a Holy Knight seriously and willingly protects the kingdom and the royal family, especially Tristan, mercilessly attacking anyone who threatens her companions.

However, Isolde has a very negative opinion about her attractiveness as a woman, because of her great height, something that caused her to be teased by other people. It is shown that she is deeply in love with Tristan, who is the only person who has not mocked or teased her, even gifting Isolde with his ribbon. She can also be quite critical of herself when it comes to her feelings for him.

But despite her serious personality, Isolde is also a sensitive, innocent and kind-hearted girl who cares a lot about others.

node.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A childhood friend of Lala, infamously known for wearing girl clothing during his play dates with Lala. At first he arrives on Earth to win back Lala, but soon becomes jealous due to her relationship with Rito. As Ren is from Planet Memorze, he can change gender in both mind and body upon sneezing; as a girl she goes by the name Run. Run likes Rito, while Ren is in competition (albeit rather one sided) with Rito for Lala's hand in marriage. ~!In To LOVE-Ru Darkness, Run and Ren are finally separated from each other. It's also revealed that Memorzians is separating while reaching adulthood.!~

Yayoi is a classmate and friend of Suzu Kanade. She always hangs out with Lucy.
Soga Ninokuru is a ninja exorcist from the Ninokuru family and considers Matsuri Kazamaki as his rival.
Garaku Utagawa is a ayakashi born from an ink brush, who has a human form and identity as a famous painter.

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Vash is an outlaw, commonly referred to as "The Humanoid Typhoon" due to the carnage and destruction left in his wake. Feared as a ruthless desperado, Vash is actually a man who hates violence and would much rather spread his message of "LOVE AND PEACE!"

name.native: ニコラス・D・ウルフウッド

node.description: He is a priest who wields a large cross-shaped gun named the Punisher, which he and his former colleagues use either in saving people or for complete destruction. After showing potential in the orphanage in which he was raised, Chapel trained and modified him, giving him enhanced abilities and the ability to regenerate from heavy injuries using special vials. He was given a special large cross-shaped gun called the Punisher, which contains two machine guns and a rocket launcher. Wolfwood is found nearly dead in the desert by protagonist [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede). They become recurring allies despite acting on different morals when fighting.

Milly Thompson is a fellow Bernardelli agent and friend and assistant to [Meryl](https://anilist.co/character/713/Stryfe-Meryl). Despite physically towering over Meryl, Milly looks up to her and always refers to her as "senpai," or "Ma'am" in the English Version, as a term of respect for a senior.

Although physically very strong, she appears rather simple and ditzy, but has an extremely kind heart and also reveals a strength of character and genuine optimism. However, Milly can be just as hotheaded as Meryl if someone is disrespectful towards their family (or wasting food, especially pudding). She can seem somewhat dim, but she has some amazing skills (chess playing, for one) which hint at a deeply buried intelligence. She does have a tendency to go a bit overboard when drinking.

She seemed to pick up on the fact that [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) is the notorious Stampede before Meryl, but she is apparently still somewhat surprised upon realizing that she was correct. Milly comes from a very large family, and writes letters to them constantly (known as "The Milly Monthly").

Somehow Milly manages to hide a very heavy concussion gun (referred to as a "stun-gun") under her coat. The shots, which pop out into the shape of an X-shaped claw, are so powerful they can even knock over trucks. At one point Milly refers to herself as "Stun-gun Milly".

Meryl Stryfe and her junior co-worker [Milly](https://anilist.co/character/714/Thompson-Milly) were sent by the Bernardelli Insurance Society to evaluate claims regarding [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede). Despite her serious attitude and short temper, she is a good person.

Although she doesn't often fight alongside Vash, she hides many derringer-style "throwaway" pistols under her coat. She once referred to herself as "Derringer Meryl".

Initially, she finds Vash to be a nuisance and dismisses the idea that he is the legendary Humanoid Typhoon. As time passes, she realizes that Vash isn't the villain that he is made out to be nor the buffoon that he presents himself to be. Gradually, she comes to respect Vash and love him deeply.

It is also hinted near the end of the anime that she may possibly be the reincarnation of [Rem Saverem](https://anilist.co/character/1180/Saverem-Rem). This, however, is not present in the manga, and may have been an independent decision by the producers of the anime. Another source of this belief is through the construction of her name, where as Meryl = Mer-yl = Rem

It is hinted that Meryl has problems involving her family. Early in Trigun Maximum, she celebrates her 23rd birthday, which means she was 21 at the beginning of Trigun.

Meryl is very short, more so in the manga than in the anime.

name.native: ミリオンズ・ナイブズ

node.description:
As Trigun unfolds, it becomes apparent that Knives believes that humans are parasites that need to be exterminated. He wants to create a peaceful and fair world with [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) and his other plant brethren, and he believes the only way to do this is by killing off all humans. 

Knives never claims to be a god; simply a superior being to homosapiens. If Knives were able to kill all humans and begin creating his "Eden" on Gunsmoke, it is very likely that he would act similarly to Vash, and act as a kind and loving individual.

name.native: レガート・ブルーサマーズ

node.description:
__Race:__ Modified Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Hair:__ Blue
__Eyes:__ Gold
__Height:__ About 6'1" (185 cm)
__Weight:__ Unknown
__Status:__ Leader of the Gung-Ho Guns

Legato was recruited by Knives after the July incident to make Vash's life a living hell, though the nightmare doesn't really begin until about midway through the series. From that point on, this man continues to weave a living nightmare for Vash, not only on his own but also through the gang of eleven superpowered killers who are under his command: the Gung-Ho Guns.

Legato himself possesses a dark power: the ability to control people's bodies against their will. 
~!His favorite bit of poetic justice is to make gangs of people who oppose him shoot each other, and this special power is what finally forces Vash to cross the line he promised himself he'd never cross. By controlling some villagers and pointing their guns at Meryl and Milly, he forced Vash into a choice between two unacceptable options: either allow the girls to die, or take the only possible action to save them...and kill him.    

Legato's telekinetic powers come from the fact that he has Vash's left arm. When Knives shot it off, it was attached to Legato. This is why Legato can control other people's bodies (originally one of Vash's and Knives' powers) and can activate Vash's angel arm the same way Knives did in July.    

It is unclear how Vash's arm was transplanted to Legato, since Vash is a humanoid plant and Legato is human. One might think that perhaps Legato is also a humanoid plant, but it is made clear in the series that Legato is human and hates himself because of it. Thus we can only assume that Knives somehow "reconstructed" and modified Legato in some way.!~

Rem left the Earth aboard Project Seeds when the planet's resources were all consumed and it became inhospitable. In their search for a new home, the remnants of humanity, with their cryogenically frozen human cargo in tow, traveled the stars and came upon a young Vash and Knives alone on a hostile planet. While most of the crew wanted to exterminate them, Rem stood in the way and saved them. She was treated by Vash and Knives like human beings, and not monsters.  

Rem is Vash's inspiration. She's the reason why he won't kill, for she once had said "No one has the right to take the life of another." She's also the inspiration for Vash choosing to wear a red coat. Rem's favorite flower was the red geranium, a flower that symbolized unshakable determination. Wearing the red coat not only reminds him of Rem, but also reminds him of his promise not to kill and to help others.

Livio the Double Fang is a childhood friend of [Wolfwood](https://anilist.co/character/722/Wolfwood-Nicholas-D) and the final member of the Gung-Ho Guns from the Eye of Michael. He wields the Double Fangs, two small cross-shaped machine guns strapped on his arms that fire from both ends.

Midvalley the Hornfreak is a violent musician who is able to use his saxophone, Sylvia, to synchronize sound waves with pain, causing physical damage. He also is capable of neutralizing sounds by playing counter-frequencies. He and his band originally just kill for money until being found by Knives, who kills all except Midvalley. He dislikes both Legato and Knives, which leads him to try to kill Legato, though he is quickly killed himself. Legato uses Midvalley's body to attack Hoppered, and it is buried with his saxophone on his gravestone afterward. He has a smaller role in the anime, mainly acting as Legato's bodygaurd until fighting Vash, and killing himself after overloading his saxophone.    from wikipedia

The most mysterious of the Gung-Ho Guns. His portrayal in both the anime and manga are drastically different.    In the anime, Zazie uses the identity of a young boy named "Beeb" as a disguise. He can control sand-worms with a high-frequency device he wears on his head.    The anime never exactly gives a clear explanation as to what Zazie was. It can be theorized that Zazie was a malevolent entity that took control of the boy whenever it needed to, that he was in fact a much older man who only looked like a young boy, or that he was actually a child assassin driven to the brink of insanity by his association with the Guns.    In the manga...   ~!his body is controlled by a collective of group-minded insects. These insects are the original inhabitants of the planet Gunsmoke and have formed an alliance with Knives to see whether humans or Plants are better to co-exist with. The insects that form Zazie also seem to represent the planet's consciousness, as represented by the sandworms he can control as well (Zazie has been referred to as the 'leader of the sandworms' by Knives). His body is destroyed by Hoppered for spying on him and Midvalley. Zazie later reappears in the body of a teenage girl. In Trigun Maximum 11 this body is destroyed as well after trying to implant an insect in Knives to control him. Zazie reappears one last time as an odd-looking man in disco-clothing in order to deliver his coin to Vash. It is revealed that these bodies are human, but are controlled by a small worm-like creature that lives inside it, similar to the one Zazie tried to implant in Knives. When the hive is destroyed by Knives, the man spits out the creature and has no memories of his time as host to Zazie.!~    His Gung-Ho Gun number is 12 in the manga, and 4 in the anime.    Info - Wikipedia

name.native: エレンディラ・ザ・クリムゾンネイル

node.description: The thirteenth Gung-Ho Gun and the most powerful, also referred to as "lost" number 13. She shoots giant red nails from a large briefcase that transforms into a crossbow. Like Vash, Elendira often acts childish and flippant, as well as flamboyant and sometimes extremely arrogant. She is a trans woman, and normally wears feminine clothing and a pillbox hat similar in style to fashions internationally popularized by Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis. However, underneath her outer garments she also wears restraining armour, and after disabling it, she is able to move at an even more inhuman speed than she is usually capable of. She seems to dislike Legato and fires a nail into Legato's torso in a conversation with him after arriving on a Zeppelin. It is also hinted that she holds some jealousy of Legato, commenting that Legato's lack of a number in the Gung-Ho Guns implies that Legato is on a whole other level from the Gung-Ho Guns, including Elendira herself.    The only manga Gung-Ho Gun who does not carry one of the broken coins, Elendira did not appear at all in the anime.
The sister of Vash and Knives.

Chapel the Evergreen is part of the "Eye of Michael", an organization of assassins founded by a church that worships Plants. They provide Knives with mercenaries, with three slots of the Gung-Ho Guns reserved for the Eye of Michael's best. Chapel, also known as 'Master C', is shot and left as a paraplegic by Wolfwood, who impersonates Chapel. He is only middle aged, but the modifications on his body, which grants him enhanced strength and reflexes, and allows him to heal at a very fast rate, have aged him considerably. Though in a wheelchair, he still wields a large cross-shaped machine gun with four spiked ends at the base of the cross. Wolfwood kills Chapel with an immense head butt, cracking his skull and breaking his neck.    The anime features Chapel the Evergreen as Wolfwood's direct mentor. He carries the parent version of Wolfwood's Cross Punisher, though Chapel's splits into twin machine guns. He cares for Nicholas after Nicholas kills his abusive guardian. He dresses in dark green and has red goggles grafted to his face. He is killed by Knives after an unsuccessful attempt to kill Legato for taking control of him and forcing him to kill Wolfwood.    from wikipedia

Hoppered the Gauntlet is a man who wears a set of armor to cover his degenerated and vestigial legs, while using his large arms to move. The armor acts like a top and he uses a shield to propel himself at high speeds. He seeks to kill Vash to avenge a mute and blind woman detached from the world, killed during the destruction of July. During his final battle, he sees Vash's memory of July, has a revelation that he has made the wrong choice, and he is killed after turning against the Guns. The anime does not feature his backstory, and instead has him just wish to make Vash suffer. He is killed by the explosion of the energy core after jumping onto it.    from wikipedia

Leonof the Puppet-Master is an elderly man who controls a large number of puppets with an elaborate system of strings. He can manipulate them to look like real people, and uses them to do horrible things to people close to Vash. His real name is Emilio, having known Vash during his childhood. His love interest dies sometime after, and he goes into puppet making to mend his broken spirit.     from wikipedia

Brad is a member of the floating platform found in episode 20 and 21 of the popular series "Trigun". Living on the floating platform his entire life bred a feeling of animosity towards those who lived upon the ground (such as Vash and Wolfwood). He fell in love with another member of the floating society, Jessica, who unfortunately was head over heels for Vash.

sampleCharacters.name: Milly Thompson
sampleCharacters.description: Milly Thompson is a fellow Bernardelli agent and friend and assistant to [Meryl](https://anilist.co/character/713/Stryfe-Meryl). Despite physically towering over Meryl, Milly looks up to her and always refers to her as "senpai," or "Ma'am" in the English Version, as a term of respect for a senior. Although physically very strong, she appears rather simple and ditzy, but has an extremely kind heart and also reveals a strength of character and genuine optimism. However, Milly can be just as hotheaded as Meryl if someone is disrespectful towards their family (or wasting food, especially pudding). She can seem somewhat dim, but she has some amazing skills (chess playing, for one) which hint at a deeply buried intelligence. She does have a tendency to go a bit overboard when drinking. She seemed to pick up on the fact that [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) is the notorious Stampede before Meryl, but she is apparently still somewhat surprised upon realizing that she was correct. Milly comes from a very large family, and writes letters to them constantly (known as "The Milly Monthly"). Somehow Milly manages to hide a very heavy concussion gun (referred to as a "stun-gun") under her coat. The shots, which pop out into the shape of an X-shaped claw, are so powerful they can even knock over trucks. At one point Milly refers to herself as "Stun-gun Milly".

sampleCharacters.name: Legato Bluesummers
sampleCharacters.native: レガート・ブルーサマーズ
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Modified Human __Age:__ Unknown __Hair:__ Blue __Eyes:__ Gold __Height:__ About 6'1" (185 cm) __Weight:__ Unknown __Status:__ Leader of the Gung-Ho Guns Legato was recruited by Knives after the July incident to make Vash's life a living hell, though the nightmare doesn't really begin until about midway through the series. From that point on, this man continues to weave a living nightmare for Vash, not only on his own but also through the gang of eleven superpowered killers who are under his command: the Gung-Ho Guns. Legato himself possesses a dark power: the ability to control people's bodies against their will. ~!His favorite bit of poetic justice is to make gangs of people who oppose him shoot each other, and this special power is what finally forces Vash to cross the line he promised himself he'd never cross. By controlling some villagers and pointing their guns at Meryl and Milly, he forced Vash into a choice between two unacceptable options: either allow the girls to die, or take the only possible action to save them...and kill him. Legato's telekinetic powers come from the fact that he has Vash's left arm. When Knives shot it off, it was attached to Legato. This is why Legato can control other people's bodies (originally one of Vash's and Knives' powers) and can activate Vash's angel arm the same way Knives did in July. It is unclear how Vash's arm was transplanted to Legato, since Vash is a humanoid plant and Legato is human. One might think that perhaps Legato is also a humanoid plant, but it is made clear in the series that Legato is human and hates himself because of it. Thus we can only assume that Knives somehow "reconstructed" and modified Legato in some way.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Livio
sampleCharacters.description: Livio the Double Fang is a childhood friend of [Wolfwood](https://anilist.co/character/722/Wolfwood-Nicholas-D) and the final member of the Gung-Ho Guns from the Eye of Michael. He wields the Double Fangs, two small cross-shaped machine guns strapped on his arms that fire from both ends.

sampleCharacters.name: Midvalley the Hornfreak
sampleCharacters.description: Midvalley the Hornfreak is a violent musician who is able to use his saxophone, Sylvia, to synchronize sound waves with pain, causing physical damage. He also is capable of neutralizing sounds by playing counter-frequencies. He and his band originally just kill for money until being found by Knives, who kills all except Midvalley. He dislikes both Legato and Knives, which leads him to try to kill Legato, though he is quickly killed himself. Legato uses Midvalley's body to attack Hoppered, and it is buried with his saxophone on his gravestone afterward. He has a smaller role in the anime, mainly acting as Legato's bodygaurd until fighting Vash, and killing himself after overloading his saxophone. from wikipedia

node.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")
__Rank/Role:__ Top-class devil (Pure devil)/ King
__Power:__ Power of destruction

A 12th grade student and the prettiest girl in the academy. Comes from the old noble of pure devils, the house of Gremory, a top-class devil who is called a genius nicknamed "Crimson Ruin Princess". Her brother is in fact one of the Yondai-Maou, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343). Both of them possess the power of destruction. She revives [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387) as her servant after finding him dead, killed by a fallen-angel and possessing a rare Sacred Gear. Kind and soft to her servants, becomes a totally different person when training or fighting.

~!She begins to develop romantic feelings for Issei in Volume 2 of the light novel and moves in with him at the volume's end.  In Volume 10, he confesses that he loves her and she returns his feelings. They begin dating after that.!~

__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the vocalist and rhythm guitarist in the band Poppin'Party.

When she viewed the stars one night as a child, she heard a sparkling "Star Beat" and had been searching for it. She believes that she found it after founding Poppin'Party. She also has a little sister named [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/152338/Toyama-Asuka), who she calls "Aa-chan". It's not always clear who is the more responsible out of the two.

Cheerful and always in high spirits, Kasumi is a playful, active and generally positive girl that always finds something to be excited about. She is capable of sharing a mental wavelength with [Kokoro Tsurumaki](https://anilist.co/character/127272/Tsurumaki-Kokoro), something nobody else seems to be able to do. She is also the type to believe in (or fall for) the strangest explanations. However, Kasumi is also quite forgetful, tending to do important things by last moment (though unintentionally so). She loves to tease [Arisa](https://anilist.co/character/120230/Ichigaya-Arisa), but given Kasumi's kind personality, it's hard to tell if she is deliberately trying to provoke her or if she's oblivious. At times she can also behave melodramatically.

__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Instrument:__ Gibson Les Paul Custom Chambered Blackout Stallion Red Guitar

A student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the main vocalist and rhythm guitarist of [Afterglow](https://anilist.co/staff/156176/Afterglow). She is the only child of the masters of a flower arrangement school that dates back to over 100 years ago. Ran is strong-willed, hates losing, and treasures her friends and family deeply. Despite this, she founded Afterglow with her childhood friends as an attempt to rebel against her father, who wants her to inherit the school. She considers [Yukina Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina) somewhat of a rival.

Ran has an aloof nature, which hides her loneliness from other people. Deep down, she wishes to become closer to others, but can be socially awkward and has a tendency to trip over her words. She can be easily flustered and is somewhat hot-blooded. She keeps her problems to herself and brushes off others' attempts to help, but while she may appear cold or detached, the warmer side to her is best seen in her quiet fondness towards her friends, primarily the other members of Afterglow. Ran observes the other members while remaining unobtrusive and cares for them greatly; she often asks about their well-being or laughs at their jokes, albeit subtly.

She has a tendency of saying "same as always" (itsumodoori), which usually means the band has done their best. She also has a habit of leaving others "on read", only reading text messages sent to her without replying to them.

__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

__Height:__ 150 cm

Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer.

A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

__Height:__ 159 cm

The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady.

Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

__Height:__ 170 cm

Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else!

An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

alternative: Supreme Ruler of the Century's End

node.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

__Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Spica

Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine.

Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

__Height:__ 140 cm

Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of!

A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) make for a good comedic duo.

__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

Always chasing shadows... Quite the mysterious Umamusume.

A mysterious girl who blends in with the shadows... and speaks with them. She can often be found sticking close to the walls, tracing odd patterns with her fingertips. According to her, however, she's always with her "friend." She enjoys sipping a nice cup of coffee, as gulping it down too quickly hurts her stomach.

Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!

An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

__Height:__ 140 cm

No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!

She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. 

She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

__Height:__ 157 cm

Don't expect much from her. This Umamusume is super cynical.

An Umamusume of humble background with a penchant for being pessimistic. She tends to think of herself as a supporting character, and this causes her to shy away from high expectations—this sometimes leads to imperfect performances. She has quite the knack for cooking and cleaning due to her working-class upbringing, and does so whenever she has time. She's something of a familiar face among the seniors in her town.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose.

Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

__Height:__ 165 cm

The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute!

Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

__Height:__ 146 cm

Turbo boost! This wild charger knows no limits!

A student brimming with youthful energy who just wants to run, run, run like crazy! She doesn't really know her own limits yet, so she has a tendency to hit them full-force, but she seems to be enjoying life on the wild side. She's a bit immature compared to the other runners her age, and she can be a bit selfish, but it's hard to fault her honest, whimsical personality.

__Height:__ 164 cm

In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.

Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

__Height:__ 135 cm (Season 2) / 158 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Capella

Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx!

Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

__Height:__ 157 cm

The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.

A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. 

~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

__Height:__ 155 cm

Straightforward and positive-thinking, this model student always gives 110 percent! But despite her efforts, her inner ditz often has her fumbling in crucial moments. The ups and downs balance out into results that are—according to her—completely average. She sometimes wishes she could be more like the strong personalities around her, but she's determined to charge through and find success her own way!

__Height:__ 156cm

Good vibes only! For real, for real! No cap! ☆ Who's ready to party? This racer!

"I'm so loud?! Well, DUH, if you're gonna do something, you gotta make it FUN! And if you wanna call that cringe, I'll just crank it up even louder! ♪" That's the mindset of this bright, chatty runner. Get ready for smilemaxxing and par-tays, 'cause she's in it to enjoy it. Helios is never one to turn down an invitation, and has a way of making every occasion a blast.

The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre.

A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on all the timeーno matter what. Her best friend and roommate, Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless. 

~!As a fast umamusume who came from America with winning streaks of six, she quickly earns a place as one of the favorites of the audiences. But she came to a first loss on her seventh race.!~

~!Later on, she went overseas to train for an upcoming race. She unfortunately lost against Broye in the race which made her strive harder to get faster and train even more.!~

**Height**: 160cm

Ambitious with a timid heart. Aiming to become a great Umamusume.

She's introverted, withdrawn, and has an inferiority complex about her talented older and younger sisters. She spends her time working hard to hopefully surpass them both one day, and have her own abilities acknowledged. She's not on bad terms with either of her siblings... but they both have a glamorous temperament, which makes her a bit out of place when they're together.

__Height:__ 168 cm

Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing.

No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

title.native: 青の祓魔師 終夜篇

node.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

The fifteen-year-old protagonist of the story, Rin is the son of [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449) born from a human woman and is the inheritor of Satan's powers. His powers were sealed at birth into the demon-slaying blade Kurikara, or Koumaken, by [Mephisto Pheles](https://anilist.co/character/30432), allowing him to live a normal human life for about 15 years.

Shura Kirigakure is a Knight and an Upper-First Class Exorcist. Having trained under the guidance of Shirou Fujimoto, she officially works as an inspector for the Vatican, but has infiltrated True Cross Academy, first as a student under the name Yamada, and later as a teacher for the Exwires. She is currently the mentor of Rin Okumura.

name.native: メフィスト・フェレス

node.description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") 

Pheles is the Chairman of True Cross Academy and also an Exorcist. After Fujimoto's death Pheles was ordered to kill Rin, however he accepted Rin's proposal in becoming an Exorcist and entered him into True Cross Academy. It has been heavily implied that he is the son of Satan along with his brother, the Earth King, Amaimon. He possesses the unique and peculiar ability of transforming into a small dog after counting down from three in German. How powerful he is has not been shown but he has mentioned that he is an honorary knight, the position two ranks below Paladin. He has been shown responsible for allowing several higher class demons onto campus. His name is an obvious pun on the word Mephistopheles, which is name for the another infamous devil, similar to his father Satan.

A two-tailed cat demon (nekomata).  Formerly Fujimoto's familiar but is now Rin's familiar.  Kuro is a Cat Sith who was once worshipped as a protective deity for silkworms.  He usually takes the appearance of a kitten, but he can reach an enormous size at will.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Yukio is Rin Okumura's twin and younger brother and Shiro Fujimoto's adopted son. He is a Middle First Class Exorcist who has started his training to become an Exorcist at seven by his father suggestion and, since then, gained the titles of Dragoon and Doctor at only fourteen, becoming the youngest Exorcist in the True Cross Order history. Yukio is also the youngest teacher of the True Cross' Exorcist Cram School, at which he teaches pharmacology. Before he was born, he has had a weak body that couldn't bear the power of the blue flames, causing the power of Satan to be fully inherited by Rin. He is seen as an ​example and prodigy by the ones who live together with him and is friends with Shiemi Moriyama, who calls him Yuki-chan.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'8")

Shirou Fujimoto was [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio)'s guardian and was also considered to be one of the most powerful Exorcists in the world. He was thought to be the only man in the world that was able to sustain possession by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) himself and thus Satan was constantly after his body. Fujimoto had a familiar sith cat demon, which he called [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/43187/Kuro), that Rin had inherited. He was a confirmed Aria, Dragoon and tamer and could possibly have been a Knight and a Docter as two of those who have studied under him have become these. He was said to be the strongest exorcist on the planet and was the only one to gain the rank of Paladin, the highest rank of the exorcists.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")    

Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi had talent in becoming a Tamer, as she was able to summon a Greenman Spirit during class. It is apparently a rare talent to possess amongst the Exorcists, where there are only a few who can control demons and fight.

__Height:__ 164 cm

Izumo Kamiki is a top student at the Exorcism Cram School of True Cross Academy who comes from a long line of shrine maidens.

__Height:__ 181 cm

He is [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) rival and the prodigy in the class. He was the child of the Cursed Temple which was destroyed by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) 16 years ago. Bon takes everything seriously and is trying his hardest in order to become an Exorcist powerful enough so he could one day defeat Satan ( a goal he claims Rin stole from him) and rebuild his Temple. Currently Bon is trying to acquire the title of Meister in both Aria (a person who recites holy texts to kill certain demons) and Dragoon (a person who fights with heavy artillery). He is currently an Exwire. He is good at memorization, cleaning and Zen meditation.

__Height:__ 176 cm

Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

alternative: Yuri Frederick Egin (ユリ ・フレデリク・エギン)

node.description: Yuri Egin is the daughter of the Candial and Yukio and Rin's Mother.    ~!Yuri let herself voluntarily be possessed by Satan and give birth to his children to prove that humans and demons could live and love together. She died after she gave birth to Rin and Yukio. !~

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") 

He is an Arc Knight and an Exorcist of the True Cross Order.

~!He is the traveling companion and right-hand man of Arthur A. Angel, which makes him ranked second in the True Cross Order.!~

~!He reveals that he doesn't experience empathy towards people, and has always lacked this ability since he was born!~
Satan is the king of Gehenna. It has been said that he is the creator of every demon in existence. There is no body in Assiah powerful enough to host him because of his incredible powers.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.
Mamushi is a Middle First-Class Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Nishiki and Ao Houjou.

name.native: アーサー・オーギュスト・エンジェル

node.description:
The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn.

Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

Kinzou is the fourth son of the Shima family, Renzou's older brother. He seems to be a pretty simple guy who is ruled by his emotions, kicking his little brother in the head as a greeting and paying no attention to the conversation at breakfast, preferring to stuff his face.
Ryuuji Suguro's father. Survivor of the Blue Night, when scores of clergymen were massacred by Satan. Known as the "Priest of the Cursed Temple."  (source: BlueExorcist.com)

Juuzou is the 2nd son of the Shima family, his younger brothers include Kinzou and Renzou. As the 2nd son, he has more responsibilities than his younger brothers. Since the 1st son of the Shima family was killed in the Blue Night incident 16 years ago, Juuzou is the successor of the Shima family. He and Houjou Mamushi are childhood friends and attended the Exorcist cramschool together.

The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati.

(Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)

name.native: イゴール・ネイガウス

node.description:
__Nationality:__ Polish

An Upper First Class Exorcist as well as lecturer in the Academy, who obtained the titles of Tamer, Doctor and Aria. He wears an eyepatch over his left eye, while he has Aria incantations tattooed on both arms.   He had a run-in with Satan when he was younger, which robbed him of his family and his left eye's sight, which is why he holds immense hatred for Satan and demons that are related to Satan. Yet ironically, he is extremely loyal to Mephisto, willing to listen to any command of his, which is why he stopped his attacks on Rin prior to the latter becoming an Exorcist.

name.native: ミシェル・ネイガウス
alternative: ミカエラ・ネイガウス

node.description: The wife of Igor Neuhaus, she was killed on the Blue Night.   ~!But was brought back to life by someone. She was also the masked man who hunt Rin and kept the True Cross Academy students hostage.   She only appears in the anime.!~ (Source: Blue Exorcist Wikia)
Miketsu, or simply Mike, is a Byakko and Eighth in rank amongst his peers. He is Izumo Kamiki's familiar, having previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.
is an Upper First Class Exorcist, and the Chief of the True Cross Order's Kyoto Branch Office. He is the father of Juuzou, Kinzou and Renzou Shima, as well as the overall head of the Shima family.

Upper second-class exorcist of the Order, First Year Magic Circles and Seals instructor at the True Cross Academy, and Warden of the Deep Keep.
~! He has betrayed the Order as he helped steal the Left Eye of the Impure King, which used to be in the Deep Keep.!~ ~! He is a Demon Eater and has swallowed Karura the Phoenix, which has given him impressive regeneration skills. Now, he answers to the Illuminati secret society.!~

Since the 1st son of the Shima family was killed in the Blue Night incident 16 years ago, Juuzou is the successor of the Shima family. He and Houjou Mamushi are childhood friends and attended the Exorcist cramschool together.

sampleCharacters.name: Lucifer
sampleCharacters.description: The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati. (Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)

sampleCharacters.name: Igor Neuhaus
sampleCharacters.native: イゴール・ネイガウス
sampleCharacters.description: __Nationality:__ Polish An Upper First Class Exorcist as well as lecturer in the Academy, who obtained the titles of Tamer, Doctor and Aria. He wears an eyepatch over his left eye, while he has Aria incantations tattooed on both arms. He had a run-in with Satan when he was younger, which robbed him of his family and his left eye's sight, which is why he holds immense hatred for Satan and demons that are related to Satan. Yet ironically, he is extremely loyal to Mephisto, willing to listen to any command of his, which is why he stopped his attacks on Rin prior to the latter becoming an Exorcist.

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm. 

~!He was Humanity's representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God, Human (formerly)
~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~

Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing.

Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

~!The human's representative for round 6!~

name.native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Qin Shi Huang was the founder of the Qin Dynasty and the first emperor to unify China. His real name is Ying Zheng. Qin Shi Huang, also known as Shi Huang Di, literally means "First Emperor of Qin". He is widely regarded as the greatest Chinese emperor of all time despite sometimes being viewed as a tyrant.

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~
The God of destruction and one of the principal deities of Hinduism.

alternative: The God Most Trusted by the Gods

node.description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

He is the current God of the Underworld also known as Helheim.

Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

~!Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Beelzebub is a prominent deity in the Philistine Pantheon and Abrahamic Pantheon. He is also the Lord of the Flies.
~!Beelzebub is the God's representative in the 8th round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

~!Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

Heracles is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with [Buddha](https://anilist.co/character/175945/Buddha) and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity.

~!Heracles is the Gods' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Nikola Tesla is a scientist just like his real-life counterpart. He doesn't believe in things like magic or gods, claiming they are just laws of Physics.

~!He is the 8th fighter for Humanity in the Ragnarok Tournament, and his volund is with the 9th Valkyrie sister, [Gondoul](https://anilist.co/character/386569/Gondul).!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.
Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms. ~!Humanity's vanguard and representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity

Raiden Tameemon, born Tarōkochi Seki, is Humanity's representative in the fifth round of Ragnarok.

Göll described Raiden as the "incarnation of desire", being shown as a perverted and lustful man when around beautiful women. Despite this, he claims that he's always completely serious about any statement he makes.

Growing up as child, Raiden was viewed a monster by many other kids and became depressed, his mother would encourage him to use his strength for the good of the weak and always hugged him with love. From that day, Raiden took his mother's words to heart and used his strength to help the villagers around him. When the "Great Tenmei Famine" began, Raiden became saddened by the death and suffering occuring all over his village and so decided to become a sumo wrestler to raise money for his hometown.

It is said that Raiden has the strongest muscles in human history and was considered to be the best of all time.

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.
Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi. ~!Souji Okita is Humanity's representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

~!Affiliation: Gods!~

The God of Misfortune.

~!He is also the fusion of the Seven Lucky Gods, being their original form before splitting up in the past.!~

~!The Gods' representative for round 6, taking the place of Bishamonten.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Hrist is the second of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Kojirou Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/140646/Kojirou-Sasaki) during the third round of Ragnarok.!~

Apollo is a prominent deity within the Greek Pantheon. He is known as the "Sun God" and is a part of the Twelve Gods of Olympus. 

~!Apollo is the Gods' representative in the ninth round of Ragnarok.!~

node.description: [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) college classmate who offered the mixer. She works at a crossdressing bar with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) where she plays a handsome prince character. She attracts attention from women whenever she crossdresses.

Fuji works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) with a persona of a calm and collected guy with purple hair. Both in and out of character, she has an lethargic attitude but she is very attentive to her surroundings and supports others from behind the scenes. In her free time, she draws doujinshi and is always searching for reference material for her works.

Asagi is a college student and [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) friend. He has a friendly and immature personality, as well as a curiosity in all sorts of things. Somehow, he hit it off with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and he helps her with her doujinshi.

Kohaku works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) with an aggressive "Ore-sama" persona which she struggles through with trial-and-error. Her earnest personality contrasts with the absurdity of Suou and Fuji's antics.
A normal college student who is classmates with [Suou.](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) His thickheaded nature overcomes the charms of the crossdressing women.

node.description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577).

(Source: Honey's Anime)
Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

**Height:** 145 cm (4′9″)
**Camera:** Smartphone

The president of the Cinema Studies Club. When all the senior students graduated, she was left behind (alongside fellow member "Ms. Tajima"), and like the Photo Club, Sakurako's club is on the verge of being completely dismantled.

**Height:** 165 cm (5′5″)
**Camera:** Smartphone

A 4-koma manga artist, using the pen name "Akino", and was a few steps shy of becoming a full-blown NEET. Lives with her grandmother who runs a cheap sweets shop.

A substitute teacher, soon become the advisor for Outdoor Activities Club.

It is later revealed that she has already met Nadeshiko and Rin. ~!She was seen drinking incredible amounts of booze while camping with her little sister.!~

**Height:** 150 cm (4′11″)
**Camera:** Wide-angle action camera

An loves "Sacchan" (Satsuki) so much that she also joined the Photography Club. Her personal camera is a small, but tough-bodied action cam.

A girl who adored her senpai so much that she joined her Photography Club. Unfortunately, after her senpai's graduation, Satsuki was left in ruins, until she finally made the initiative to buy not just a camera -- but one that captures the world in 360-degrees!

node.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

Dejiko is the main character of Di Gi Charat. She is also known as Chocola but despite this alternate name implying she likes chocolate, she prefers broccoli. Dejiko has a Type A personality and can be aggressive at times.  Dejiko dresses up as a catgirl and is the princess of Planet Di Gi Charat. She is ten years old when she comes to Earth with hopes of becoming an idol singer. She has green eyes and green hair and her maid-like uniform consists of a white and navy blue dress with big cat bells tied to her hair with navy blue ribbons. On the very top of her head are her cat ears, which are white with pink inside and have a set of large, non-functional yellow cat eyes. She always wears white gloves and boots (with the exception of her sleeping outfit) and she has a white tail.  She has the ability to use her eye-beam weapon called the Me kara BEAM!. She ends each sentence with nyo.

Konoha has great passion for visual novels and bishoujo games. She admires both classic and modern games. She experienced big dissapointment when the company where she works at, hired her to illustrate background characters. Her biggest dream is to create her own game. 

She has a very childlike personality. She easily gets excited and prone to crying.

Alcoholsoft's chief illustrator who is extremely skilled. She has a gentle personality. 

In the anime, she is the first person at Alcoholsoft to accept Konoha and worries about her when she disappears.

Artist and planner at Alcoholsoft with a trademark cat-eared hat. She has a gentle personality and a deep passion for Bishoujo games. She has a level-headed view of the company, but in the anime, Konoha's situation weighs on her mind.

An apprentice witch striving to become a First-Class Mage. She approaches everything with a positive attitude and treats those around her with warmth and cheer. Inspired by the mage who saved her during an incident two years ago, she now pursues the same path herself. A bit of an airhead at times.

__Magic:__ Scorpio Magic

The second daughter of the Scorpio Castle Shrine, from the Eastern lands. Due to a past incident, she keeps her distance from others. A bookworm with a strong aversion to insects (except scorpions).

Spica’s childhood friend, gifted with a natural talent for just about anything. She’s intrigued by Spica’s clumsy nature and often teases her for fun.

A mage who turned into a cat due to a curse. With Spica’s power, he can temporarily lift the curse and return to human form. However, he reverts back into a cat once his magic runs out. In hopes of one day breaking the curse, he begins teaching Spica magic.

__Magic:__ Capricorn Magic

A caring and trustworthy leader, well-respected by those around her—but never call her “serious”. She admires rebels and has dabbled in martial arts… and breaking windows.

__Magic:__ Aries Magic

A carefree girl who’s almost always asleep. Easygoing and laid-back, she’s the complete opposite of her childhood friend, Capella. She needs 12 hours of sleep a day just to feel awake—but she’s surprisingly academically inclined.

__Magic:__ Taurus Magic

A kind-hearted and strong girl. Gentle by nature, though her clumsiness sometimes leads to accidents. Friends with Castor and Pollux since middle school.

__Magic:__ Leo Magic

A showy girl from a wealthy family who loves being the center of attention. Free-spirited by nature, though her dependable side occasionally shows through. She adores anything flashy, enjoys standing out, and has a fondness for animals and working out.

__Magic:__ Pisces Magic

A gentle, free-spirited girl with a dreamy air and fondness for fish. A romantic at heart, she loves to sing and dance. Her singing voice possesses the power to manipulate the emotions of anyone who hears it.

Chiron’s caretaker. Well-rounded and excels at everything, although quite meddlesome. A big fan of animals. He used to keep several cats—but pampered them so much that they all ended up overweight.

Pollux’s older brother. Rough and hot-tempered, but cares deeply for his little sister. A fan of punk rock, though he secretly thinks Lolita fashion isn't half bad either.
