node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

alternative: Supreme Ruler of the Century's End

node.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!

An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

__Height:__ 140 cm

No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!

She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. 

She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

__Height:__ 164 cm

In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.

Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

__Height:__ 157 cm

The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.

A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. 

~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

__Height:__ 166 cm

An energetic honor student! ...But also kind of a supporting character?

A spirited competitor practically overflowing with positive energy. She wants nothing more than to meet the expectations of her fans and is determined to surmount any challenge to do so. Her willingness to acknowledge and compliment her competitors' strengths has earned her the popularity and respect of her peers. Though she has the makings of a star, she often seems to find herself in more of a supporting role.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud...

As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes. Her hobbies include taking afternoon naps and fishing. She also loves cats and is often seen curling up with them outside on the grass. She's classmates with [Special Week](https://anilist.co/character/125299/Special-Week).

__Height:__ 160 cm

Always follows commands! The cyborg Umamusume.

An Umamusume also known as the "Cyborg". She views the world through the lens of programming and databases, carrying out her objectives in an expressionless and robotic manner. Even so, she is not an emotionless machine—her constant training since her youth has simply resulted in less interactions with people, leading to her current personality. Underneath that robotic shell, she does indeed have feelings.

**Height:** 143 cm

I love Umamusume! A super versatile otaku.

A veritable Umamusume otaku. She came to Tracen Academy to be close to all of her favorite runners. She does respect boundaries, however, and tries to stay out of trouble. She's eager to get up close and personal with as many Umamusume as possible, and to that end she has revealed surprising ability on both dirt and turf.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling.

A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck. If she's not divining for her own sake, then she's divining for someone else's. She places an immense faith in a revelation from a certain god stating that as long as she keeps running, the way forward will open up before her. The name of the cat shaped bag that she carries is "Miss Nya."

__Height:__ 155 cm

A shining star of pure cuteness! I need lots of love and attention, okay?

When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series.

__Height__: 158 cm

This class representative's gone wild! Full Speed Bakushiiiin!

A class representative who'll rush recklessly into any situation. Once her mind is set on something, she'll bakushin dash straight to her goal—often causing more chaos than she helps resolve. She never acts out of self-righteousness, however, and tends to feel downhearted if no one is asking for her assistance. Her aptitude for sprinting is quite overwhelming, and she is confident she can outrun anyone with unmatched speed.

__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")

A sheltered lady excited to make memories that will last a lifetime.

A lady of a distinguished family that is rumored to be royalty, she has come to Tracen as an exchange student from Ireland. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy.

__Height__: 156 cm

Leave the fanservice to her! Self-proclaimed future top Umadol.

An Umamusume idol, or Umadol for short. She's always focused on looking cute while winning, and aims to be the center at every winning concert. She loves to interact with her fans and participates in any event that may serve as good publicity. Despite being a proficient dirt racer, she has a slight complex about being associated with the unsightly substance.
[Narita Top Road](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road)'s trainer.

The public face of Rhodes Island and its top executive. Although Amiya appears to be a young and inexperienced girl, she is universally trusted and highly qualified for her position. Amiya now leads Rhodes Island in fighting for the future of the Infected and striving to exorcise the dark shadow of Originium from the land.

~!Amiya is the current holder of Civilight Eterna making her the successor of the previous "King of Sarkaz", [Theresa](https://anilist.co/character/300731/Theresa) who died in an assassination during the previous Sarkaz Civil War. She is also believed to be the "Lord of Fiends" a prophesized legend who will bring the apocalypse and the end of Terra.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Lupo
__Height:__ 161 cm

Texas is a Penguin Logistics staff member who is extraordinarily skilled in single combat. She was sent to Rhodes Island as a liaison, where she assists with a variety of operations.

__Birthday:__  Claims to have forgotten
__Place of Birth:__ Kazdel
__Race:__ Sarkaz
__Height:__ 165 cm

W, Sarkaz mercenary leader. W's squad, having been involved in Kazdel's lengthy civil war, is infamous for their brutal and efficient combat methods. W clashed with Rhodes Island during the Chernobog incident, but after defecting from Reunion for unknown reasons, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island after negotiating with [Dr. Kal'tsit](https://anilist.co/character/174803/Kaltsit) in person.

__Birthday:__ Undisclosed
__Place of Birth:__ Rhodes Island
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 169 cm

Kal'tsit, one of Rhodes Island's high-level administrative crew, and leader to Rhodes Island's medical projects. Profoundly learned in metallurgy, sociology, Originium Arts, archaeology, history and genealogy, economics, botany, geology, and other fields. In a portion of Rhodes Island operations, provides medical theory assistance and emergency aid apparatus as medical personnel. Simultaneously, active in many projects as a major constituent of Rhodes Island's command system.

Kal'tsit has the ability to summon Mont3r, a biomechanical entity that seemingly comes out of her spine and is used for self-defense and in combat.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Lung
__Height:__ 168 cm

Ch'en, head of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Royal Victorian Guard School with superb grades and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals. Now works at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command.

~!An Infected and the niece to [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Yenwu-Wei), the regional leader of Yen-Lungmen. She has shown an aptitude for Originium Arts although she has a terrible control over it. But it is implied that using a sword as the conduit to her Arts gives her greater control over her Arts.!~

~!She is the half-sister of the Reunion Movement Leader, [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah).!~

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus
__Race:__ Cautus

A Cautus Infected, born to a life of slave-mining in the Ursus tundra, FrostNova is a high-ranking member of Reunion. She leads the fearsome Yeti Squadron for special operations and is one of the few Casters who can suppress enemies in a head-on engagement. Saved by [Patriot](https://anilist.co/character/265827/Patriot) from her horrific life, FrostNova looks up to him as her father.

~!Sent by [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah) to attack Lungmen in coalition with Mephisto, they are held off by the combined efforts of Rhodes Island and Lungmen Guard Department before the Black Raincoats sweep in and lead a purge of the Lungmen Infected. With their roles now reversed, FrostNova stays back to help evacuate the slums even as her Oripathy worsens. She eventually confronts [Doctor](https://anilist.co/character/182729/Doctor) and [Amiya](https://anilist.co/character/174801/Amiya) who offer her a chance to join Rhodes Island. FrostNova agrees on the condition they beat her, on pretext of testing Amiya's resolve to defeat Talulah.!~

~!Following their fateful encounter, the Doctor takes FrostNova's body with them so she could be properly cremated in one of Rhodes Island's incineration chambers as a sign of their honour and respect towards her, now a posthumous member of Rhodes Island.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Laterano
__Race:__ Sankta
__Height:__ 159 cm

Exusiai is a citizen of Laterano and as such, is entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1-13 of the Laterano Constitution. She is an employee of Penguin Logistics who specializes in covert communication, armed escort, and other undercover activities. We suspect she is a Messenger. While contracted with Penguin Logistics, she serves as a liaison to Rhodes Island, assisting us with our operations.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen, Yan
__Race:__ Draco
__Height:__ 178 cm

Talulah is the leader of the rebel group Reunion, intent on destroying those who oppress the infected. With her striking appearance, including long silver hair and red eyes, Talulah exudes elegance and fierceness. She wields a powerful scythe-like blade called the Fallen Sword and displays exceptional combat skills, utilizing Originium manipulation to unleash devastating flames.

~!Talulah and [Ch'en](https://anilist.co/character/174797/Chen) are half-sisters as they have the same mother, [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Wei-Yenwu)'s sister.!~

~!Talulah was kidnapped and trained by Duke Kashchey. She killed him shortly after escaping, but ended up being "corrupted" by him through an ancient arts.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Higashi
__Race:__ Oni
__Height:__ 184 cm

Hoshiguma is an elite Operator from the Special Ops Team of the L.G.D. There are several charges against her on record. After intervention from Chief Wei Yenwu, L.G.D. made an exception to admit her into its Special Ops division based on her exceptional abilities and field performance. She exhibited remarkable professionalism in handling violent crime, protecting VIPs, disaster response and emergency rescue. Currently a defender assisting Rhodes Island operations, Hoshiguma provides tactical execution and command support.

__Age:__ ~!>13,000!~

Almost nothing is known about the Doctor's background and past, other than that they had a doctorate in neurology and had extensively researched Oripathy prior to the events of the story. Like Kal'tsit, their file number starts with 'B', implying a connection to Babel, the predecessor of Rhodes Island.

Currently suffering from amnesia, the Doctor was rescued by Amiya from Chernobog when Talulah led the Reunion insurgence against the Ursus empire.

~!Doctor belongs to an extinct race called "First Civilization", a space-faring civilization who colonized Terra, bringing with them animals who later evolves into the Ancients and Elders.!~

__Birthday:__ Undisclosed
__Place of Birth:__ Victoria
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 172 cm

Blaze, an elite Rhodes Island Operator, has demonstrated professional combat skills and tactical decisionmaking in mobile operations, annihilation, and raids. Now commanded by Amiya, she is a staple for when battles get tough.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 142cm

Rhodes Island Elite Operator Rosmontis possesses a high aptitude for a rare form of Originium Arts particularly adept at confronting large creatures, destroying hard objectives, immobilizing facilities under emergency, and putting a stop to small-scale skirmishes. She has been shown to possess a solid control of the battlefield and considerable tactical value in assault, positional, and annihilation scenarios. Under Kal'tsit's assignment, she is currently active as a core annihilation specialist.

__Place of Birth:__ Vouivre
__Race:__ Vouivre
__Height:__ 156 cm

Liskarm is an employee of Blacksteel Worldwide, a private security contractor that provides security and protection services to international business, state agencies and non-governmental organizations. She has a lot of combat experience in conflict zones. Liskarm is currently under contract to provide professional security and other consulting services to Rhodes Island.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Vulpo
__Height:__ 163 cm

Franka, biohazard protection and response specialist for Blacksteel Worldwide, is very experienced and proficient in VIP protection, raid, and combat support operations. She is currently undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island and providing professional security as a Blacksteel Operator.

__Place of Birth:__ Victoria
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 147 cm

A fully enlisted Operator coming from a private security firm based in Columbia. Blacksteel Worldwide, currently stationed at Rhodes Island as part of an exchange training program. A timid person, she often ends up as a test subject for whatever new equipment Blacksteel are researching because she wouldn't reject the offer made by the executives. Her timidity is the result of her selective perception that causes insecurities. In fact, she is a very capable Operator with no flaws in her operation records.

The weapon she uses, a Blacksteel-made Originium gun, is very expensive to maintain due to it using Originium rounds as ammunition, a valuable crystalline substance used in all of Terra. It is noted by her fellow Operator that she foots the bill using her personal snack money to buy the ammunition for the gun.

Patriot is a high-ranking member of the Reunion movement. He was born over 200 years ago and is the last pureblood Wendigo Sarkaz. His armor is in disrepair and damaged in many places. The blade of his once sharp halberd is now eroded with rust. However, the indomitable Patriot never capitulates, never backs down, and never shows mercy. He has long struggled with fate, and now resolves to slit the throat of fate.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Vulpo

Frostleaf is a former Columbian Junior Army soldier, 'retired' after her unit was destroyed. Came into contact with Rhodes Island later as a mercenary, before officially joining following a period of collaboration with the company. With extensive combat experience and undeniably skilled, Frostleaf is an excellent asset to Rhodes Island.

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus
__Race:__ Phidia
__Height:__ 164 cm

A Sniper who is one of Reunion's squad leaders, often working in tandem with [Mephisto](https://anilist.co/character/274330/Mephisto). He uses extremely long-range attacks to inflict devastating physical damage. He is known to occasionally use special attacks such as summoning turret-like ballistae or launching highly destructive bolts.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 163 cm

Swire, Senior Superintendent of the Lungmen Guard Department. Now a special attache at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command.

__Birthplace:__ Ursus

One of Reunion's squad leaders who handles infiltration and assassination operations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. Her stealth and superb infiltration abilities have foiled countless attempts to capture her.

Projekt Red's real identity is unknown and her background a mystery. She was taken in, raised, and protected by [Dr. Kal'tsit](https://anilist.co/character/174803/Kaltsit). 

Extremely talented in high mobility warfare, special ops and stealth combat. Projekt Red now serves as a Specialist Operator for Rhodes Island under Dr. Kal'tsit's guidance.

Ace is a Rhodes Island elite operator that plays a supporting role in the Prologue and Episode 01. Due to his actions Amiya, the Doctor, and the remainder of the Rhodes Island units were able to escape from Chernobog, letting the mission for Doctor's rescue succeed. ~!In the attempt to buy time for Amiya he was slain by Talulah.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Zalak
__Height:__ 166 cm

Lin Yühsia is a character who plays a role in Chapter 06 of the main story and Dossoles Holiday. She has the ability to convert sand into glass as well as controlling glass products.

She is the only daughter of Rat King, the undisputed godfather of Lungman's underworld. Although she would be his successor, she has not decided to take her father's place yet.

__Place of Birth:__ Undisclosed
__Race:__ Liberi
__Height:__ 162 cm

Operator GreyThroat, despite only receiving her codename recently, has actually been part of Rhodes Island for much longer than the time she's served as an Operator. Her parents were formerly Oripathy researchers who traveled around. Her mother entrusted GreyThroat to Rhodes Island before disappearing. Now, she has passed the Operator assessment and is a member of Rhodes Island's operation team.

__Place of Birth:__  Kazdel
__Race:__ Sarkaz
__Height:__ 170cm

Formerly a member of Firewatch's group, she is now a freelance mercenary. Other details of her history are unknown. Now serving as a sniper Operator for Rhodes Island, she uses the bowgun in her hands to exert lethality from afar.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Yaiba lives with his father, Kenjurou, in the forest. One day, while Yaiba was eating, a troop of gorillas came to attack. Yaiba and his father escaped and hid inside a box, but they didn't know that the box was full of pineapples and was going to be transported into the city. In the city, Yaiba finds out that he is a legendary warrior and has to fight the evil of a demonic looking high-school student named Takeshi Onimaru.
Takeshi is the primary antagonist of Yaiba. Originally a very serious person, Onimaru could not get along with Yaiba at all and the two quickly became rivals.
Yaiba's pet tiger.

One of the original eight demons who closely supported the Fuujin oni, reincarnated in the body of a frog and thus took the shape of his host.  The first demon sent after Yaiba, he led a few skirmishes against Yaiba's party, but was eventually defeated and captured. Shortly after, the Snakeman demon appeared to both attack Yaiba and get rid of the Frogman due to his uselessness. Gerozaemon, with no place to return and a peaceful nature, was welcomed into Yaiba's group after the battle against the Snakeman.    A melee fighter, he favors the use of body-slam techniques reminiscent of sumo, but can also skillfully use axes and his own tongue as weapons when needed.
Yaiba's pet vulture.
Kurogane Kenjuro is Yaiba's father.

One of the original eight demons who closely supported the Fuujin oni, reincarnated in the body of a spider and thus took the shape of his host.  Prefers to fight using head over brawns... but fails miserably at it: even though he is smart enough to create complex plans that actually work, his goofy nature causes them to backfire humorously most of the time.    He becomes Onimaru's right hand man, not because of his merits but because there was nothing better at the time. He is constantly sent to do his master's bidding, such as recruiting new warriors or gathering intel.    Even though he is part of Onimaru's ranks, he is actually not a bad guy. However, his undying loyalty towards his master is evident, but he never shows any real ill-will towards Yaiba's group. This trait also causes him to be the only one of the eight demons to back up Onimaru until the very end (the others either were slain, or changed sides), even though he is mistreated quite often.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

The Demon King's precious only daughter. She has a kind heart, which is rare among demons, and she can't help but assist anyone in trouble, no matter who they are. As a candidate to be the next Demon King, she receives special elite education from Jahi, the demon lord's close aide, so that she can become a proper demon.

An excellent aide to the Demon King. She volunteered to be [Doux's](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) tutor in order to guide her to become a respectable demon. Although she gives Doux one challenge after another, she is constantly at the mercy of Doux's excessive kindness.

[Jahi's](https://anilist.co/character/257292/Jahi) classmate. She belongs to the Parikar Squad, a group of demonic women skilled in bewitching men, but she's perpetually stuck as an apprentice, always up to mischief. To make [Doux](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) a full-fledged demon, she proposes a trial of seduction.
[Ahriman's](https://anilist.co/character/367448/) wife and [Doux's](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) mother.

On Christmas night, she gives out presents to good children according to their wishes - in other words, she has the power to make any wish come true. She sneaks into the Demon Castle with her helper, the elf [Tontt](https://anilist.co/character/387707/Tontt), but...

A first year student and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) childhood friend. Her poor eyesight makes her squint and she has naturally blonde hair so she is often mistaken for a delinquent. She often doesn't take Yuu seriously, but still cares about her and gives advice.

__Height:__ 184 cm (6’1)

Masaki Takigawa is a senior shrine priest at Yata Shrine and later becomes the coach for the Kazemai High School Kyudo Club. He holds a fifth dan rank in kyudo.

Masaki gives off the image of a mysterious, refined young man, but he is actually more laid-back and down-to-earth than he seems. He has the air of an old man despite his young age. He is noted to act roughly and sloppily in many things except in kyudo. He seems to dislike formality, asking everyone to call him "Masa-san" instead. He is friendly and good at explaining things, qualities that make him a good coach in the eyes of the members of the Kazemai kyudo club. He is also good at listening and giving advice, something he does with [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/) frequently. He is not above speaking more vulgarly, such as when coaching Minato to overcome his hayake at the Yata no Mori Kyudojo.

Despite his easy-going nature, Masaki also has a more serious and stubborn side to him when it comes to kyudo and his grandfather.

__Height:__ 175 cm (5’9)

Seiya Takehaya is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club, as well as serving as the club head and captain of the boys' division.

Seiya is viewed as a mature, reliable, and kind character, determined to facilitate and oversee [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/)'s success in kyudo. However, as he himself stated in episode two, when he gets serious, he has no need for compassion. Seiya and Minato have been friends since childhood due to being neighbors. Along with [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/), the three of them were kindergarten and elementary school friends and have had many ventures together.

__Height:__ 173 cm (5’8)

Minato Narumiya is the protagonist of the series. He is a first-year at Kazemai High School where he is a member of the kyudo club.

Minato is a reserved and withdrawn person, which resulted from after his accident in sixth grade and his target panic incident at his last middle school tournament. He is serious and responsible, always doing his chores and cleaning the school kyudojo proactively. His seriousness often causes him to get flustered by more cheerful individuals like [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) and [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/).

Despite seeming calm and indifferent, Minato has a deep passion for kyudo and is extremely loyal to his friends. He is earnest about the things he wants to do, such as improving at kyudo. Ryouhei has noted that he seemed like a "wild child" as he doesn't mind running on snow-covered roads or doesn’t get a cold when he was wading through a cold river. He has a sarcastic side to him when it comes to dealing with more eccentric people, such as [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/128729/). He is also prone to having an overactive imagination and believing scary stories.

Minato has a love for fluffy animals, especially Kuma ([Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/)'s dog) and Who (Masaki's owl).

__Height:__ 170 cm (5’7)

Nanao Kisaragi is a first-year at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.

Ever since he was little, Nanao has attracted many female admirers due to his looks and charisma. However, the side effect of this was that he also received many jealous attacks, so his mother and aunts decided to have [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/128276/), his cousin, act as his bodyguard. This worked well in elementary school, and though they went to separate middle schools, they were still in extracurriculars and cram school together. Some time in the past, Nanao used to go to the prefectural budokan to practice kyudo by himself, and one time met with a judge's teacher, from whom he learned many things about kyudo.

Gets along with [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/Yamanouchi-Ryouhei) due to their similar personalities. The two like to joke and laugh around together.

__Height:__ 178 cm (5’10")

Kaito Onogi is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.

Kaito comes off as short-tempered, overly serious, and aggressive. He is easily riled up, especially when his cousin [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) calls him Kacchan or when he perceives someone to not be taking something as seriously as he does. He is blunt with his words and not afraid to say what he really thinks. He tends to jump to conclusions. This causes people to be afraid of him. A large part of his current personality might be due to being treated as someone scary ever since he was little due to his intimidating face.

However, he is also fiercely loyal to those he becomes close to. He is a good observer, such as noticing [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/)'s issues with kyudo. He often serves as the straight man to the antics of others. His fellow members tease him for being a tsundere, much to his annoyance. He is good with cats, and has a white cat named Lucy.

__Height:__ 182 cm (6’0)

Ryouhei Yamanouchi is a first-year student at Kazemai High School where he is a member of the kyudo club.

Ryouhei was childhood friends with [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/) and [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/) and went to kindergarten and elementary school with them until he transferred in fifth grade and went to a different middle school than them. In middle school, he took kyudo classes as part of his required martial arts course.

Ryouhei greatly admires Seiya for his intelligence and kindness to everyone, and frequently praises him for it. He steadfastly refuses to believe Seiya can do anything bad. He gets along with [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) very well due to their similarly cheerful and chatty personalities. The two of them often joke around and laugh together. Their interactions are the specialty of the kyudo club.

(Source: Tsurune Fandom)

node.description:
__Species:__ Werewolf

A quiet, reserved, and passive werewolf girl who aspires to become human because she wants to be more than just a half-baked existence.

__Species:__ Rabbit

A rabbit girl with a tendency to be a little harsh. Despite her sharp tongue, she's earnest at heart, and aims to become human in order to repay the kindness of those who once helped her.

__Species:__ Mozu

A cool, gyaru Mozu girl. She's caring and acts as a leader in her class. She says she wants to become human so she can play music.

__Species:__ Dragon

A noble dragon. Seeking to understand love, she aims to become human and relentlessly pursues [Hitoma](https://anilist.co/character/374176/Rei-Hitoma) whenever she finds an opening.

__Species:__ Black Cat

A girl who speaks little, steadfastly marching to her own beat, radiating an enigmatic aura even within the classroom. Her reason for wanting to become human remains a secret. She is often seen carrying books on black magic.

__Species:__ Mermaid

A mermaid lady with a very bright and cheerful personality. She aspires to become human so that she can dance, which she loves, with her own two feet. She is always positive and optimistic, and is the mood maker.

__Species:__ Oni

A descendant of the Oni with a carefree personality. She often cracks jokes or speaks offhandedly. Chose to become human because “She doesn't want to lie.”
Yuki is a science teacher.

__Species:__ Human

A man in his 30s who loves games. For some reason, he quit his job as a teacher and stayed at his parents' house for a while, distancing himself from people. By chance, he becomes a teacher at Shiranui High School, a school where non-humans aim to become humans.

__Species:__ Rat

A young rat girl who loves to eat delicious food. She dreams of becoming human and being able to eat even more delicious food. She's emotional, honest about her desires, and a playful person.
A fresh new teacher who has just arrived at the school year. Her charming smile and friendly personality make her a great choice.

__Race:__ Elf

An elf with a high sense of beauty who lived in the treetop city of Ryfgard. In order to show the world how beautiful she was, she decided to become human.
A math teacher who loves coffee. [Hitoma](https://anilist.co/character/374176/Rei-Hitoma)'s mentor.
The principal of Shiranui High School, characterized by his petite, round form and distinctive way of speaking.

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A first-year high school student. Born and raised in Brazil, her mother is Japanese. She's a mood maker, assertive, and doesn't hesitate to speak her mind. She's skilled in capoeira, which she learned as a self-defense technique, and loves music.

**Height:** 160 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She's the captain of the powerful cheerleading club, and a skilled player who built the team from a lack of a dedicated coach to becoming a regular at the nationals in just one year. She's responsible for managing the entire team and even the budget. While clumsy, she puts her teammates first, though it's unclear if she communicates this.

__Height:__ 155 cm

A first-year student at Omaebashi High School. She loves yoga, India, and philosophy. She doesn't like being overwhelmed and lives for peace and quiet, but she's constantly at the mercy of her childhood friend, [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/324909/Anna-Aveiro). Her delusional nature causes her to engage in rambling delusions that rival those of Bollywood.

__Height:__ 145 cm

First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' High School. External student. Expressionless, taciturn, and extremely rational. She often gets talked about on social media for doing parkour to shorten her commute. In fact, she's not very dexterous, having trouble splitting chopsticks properly or tying sneaker laces properly.

__Height:__ 173 cm

First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' Academy High School. An internal student. A sheltered young lady with a father who is the next director of a general hospital and a mother who is a former model. A tall and accomplished rhythmic gymnast, she is known as the "Fairy of Numata." Her earnest, humble, hardworking, and kind nature have earned her a devoted fanbase at school.

__Height:__ 155 cm

A first-year high school student. She's cheerful, energetic, and loves cheerleading. Despite her bad luck, she's an exceptional athlete and won the national cheerleading championship in middle school. She and her best friend, [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/324911/Megumi-Kaionji), are aiming to win the national cheerleading championship in high school as well.

__Height:__ 158cm

The daughter of Shurinji Temple, a temple in Numata. In middle school, she was captain of the cheerleading club, but was hospitalized due to illness during a tournament. She is currently undergoing rehabilitation and recuperating at home. To fulfill her promise to [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/324907/Kanata-Misora), she is a hard worker who studies diligently in order to transfer to Takanosaki High School. She is responsible and caring, but also has a tendency to tease Kanata. She is skilled at coming up with practice schedules and performances.

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She started cheerleading in high school and, through steady effort, has risen to the A team. She is very caring and tutors her juniors, including [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/324907/Kanata-Misora), not only in cheerleading but also in academics. Currently, for some reason, she serves as a practice assistant.

__Height:__ 168 cm

Miyabi is a specialist in dance and tumbling who captivates audiences. A self-proclaimed dance enthusiast recognized by all for studying various dance forms like contemporary dance and classical dance to expand their solo repertoire. Possesses a realistic and severe side.

**Height**: 175 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. Tall and with a model-like figure, [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/339769/Hana-Nabatame) hates standing next to her. Despite her calm personality, she takes extra pride in supporting the team as a base. She remains unfazed even in times of crisis.

**Height**: 142 cm

A second-year student at Takanosaki High School. She is the star of the cheerleading team. While selfish and proud, she has a passionate personality and never stops working hard to remain the A-Team's leader. She has an angelic smile during performances and a strict, fiery attitude during practice, but she never forgets to be grateful to those around her, believing that "the top members can shine thanks to the supporters and spotlights."

name.native: ビクトリア・セラーズ

node.description:
A former operative skilled in a wide range of areas, including disguise, forgery, and combat techniques. 

Although she chose to leave the organization and live under the alias "Victoria," she struggles to fully break ties with her past and is awkward when it comes to pursuing her own happiness. However, through her encounters with Nonna and Jeffrey, she begins to carve out a new life for herself.

A young girl whom Victoria took in after she had been abandoned. 

Though she initially understood her situation and was quiet and well-behaved, she gradually becomes more emotionally expressive while living with Victoria. She deeply adores Victoria and has a profound impact on her, becoming a truly cherished presence in her life.

name.native: ジェフリー・アッシャー

node.description:
The commander of the Second Knight Order, responsible for guarding the capital of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a man of integrity who enjoys the deep trust of those around him. 

When Victoria took Nonna under her protection, he stepped forward to act as her guarantor. Although he had long avoided falling in love due to emotional scars from an incident ten years prior, he finds himself drawn to the refreshing charm of Victoria, who lives her life with independence and spirit.

The proprietor of "The Black Thrush," a tavern located in the backstreets of the royal capital. He takes a liking to the way Victoria quietly enjoys her drink when she visits the establishment. 

Seeming well-versed in the affairs of the underworld, he and Victoria sense that neither of them is an ordinary individual.

name.native: コンラッド・アシュベリー

node.description:
The Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a thoughtful and gentle-natured man who holds Geoffrey in high regard and is fond of him. 

Upon learning of Victoria—with whom Geoffrey is close—he seeks to give Geoffrey a push in the right direction.

name.native: クラーク・アンダーソン

node.description:
Jeffrey's nephew. 

He had lost confidence because he struggled with both foreign languages ​​and athletics, but after being tutored by Victoria, he discovered the joy of learning. He has a sensitive yet open nature and becomes close with Nonna, who attends lessons alongside him.

name.native: セドリック・アシュベリー

node.description:
The second prince of the Kingdom of Ashbury. 

In stark contrast to his older brother Conrad, he possesses a cheerful and energetic personality. His straightforward nature—free of pretense—has earned him the affection of his subordinates. 

Confident in his swordsmanship, he becomes intrigued after hearing rumors of Victoria's formidable skill.

The leader of the Haguru Kingdom's special operations unit. 

He took Victoria away from her impoverished family when she was young and raised her within the organization as the operative "Chloe." To Chloe, he was not only her superior but also a figure she looked up to like an older brother.

The widow of the late Earl of Haynes. 

She met Victoria following a purse-snatching incident and ended up renting the estate's annex to her, as Victoria was looking for a place to stay. She took a great liking to Victoria—who is cultured and an excellent cook—and became very fond of both her and Nonna.

name.native: エドワード・アッシャー

node.description:
Jeffrey’s older brother. 

Although he is the head of a count’s family, he serves as the de facto leader of the Ashbury Royal Castle’s Department for the Maintenance and Management of Systems—commonly known as the Third Knight Order. Devoted to his younger brother, he takes an interest in Victoria upon learning that Jeffrey—who had long kept his distance from women—has grown close to her.

name.native: バーナード・フィッチャー

node.description:
He is Jeffrey’s uncle and a renowned historian. 

Possessing a difficult temperament that caused previous assistants and servants to quit quickly, he hires Victoria as his new assistant and housemaid. He grows fond of Victoria—who is fluent in multiple languages ​​and adept at household chores like cleaning and cooking—and gradually becomes gentler in nature.

Baki is the son of [Yuujirou Hanma](https://anilist.co/character/10499/Hanma-Yuujirou) and [Emi Akezawa](https://anilist.co/character/10500/Akezawa-Emi). ~!Baki is also the half-brother of [Jack Hanma](https://anilist.co/character/16875/Hammer-Jack).!~

~!Baki has trained in martial arts since age three, turning to independent, intense training at thirteen to follow in his father's footsteps before vowing to defeat him. He utilizes a versatile "Total Fighting" style and advanced shadowboxing that turns visualizations into corporeal forms to master opponents' techniques. After winning the underground arena tournament against his half-brother Jack in the finals, he survives encounters with escaped convicts, defeats [Biscuit Oliva](https://anilist.co/character/35484/Biscuit-Oliva), and clashes with the prehistoric man [Pickle](https://anilist.co/character/54859/Pickle).!~

~!During Chapter 312 of Hanma Baki, Baki makes Yuujirou forfeit his title of the "Strongest Creature Alive" after making him concede in their fight!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

The father of Baki and Jack Hanma. He is the strongest creature in the world, and is known to have mastered all styles of unarmed combat. His repertoire apparently includes all of the well-known fighting styles (such as karate, boxing, taekwondo, judo, jujutsu, wrestling, street-fighting, and so on) as well as some more esoteric ones (such as the udonde or uzunde style, an actual system used in the Motobu style of karate). He has been fighting on the battlefields, using only his bare hands, since the age of sixteen, when he fought against both American and Vietcong in the Vietnam War. Since then, it appears that he has obtained respect from the American forces, and has begun fighting as a kind of mercenary for them. It is said that when he stopped fighting for survival but for pleasure the image of the demon's face appeared on his back.

Fifteen-year-old yakuza leader and strongman. When his father died, he was adopted by his uncle who saw great potential in him. His grip is so strong that if he grabs an opponent's arm, he can usually cause it to explode from restricting the blood flow. He is also a street fighter and it is unknown if he has trained in martial art styles. He broke Yuri Chakosky's arm, thus ending his boxing career, but when then cross paths again they hold no grudge against each other understanding each other's warrior spirit. (Source: Wikipedia)
Jack Hammer is a powerful Canadian pit fighter who appears at the beginning of Season 2 of the anime, the Maximum Tournament Arc.

Chinese Kung-Fu (referred to as "Kenpo" in Japanese) practitioner. Trained in China and became the heir to his Kung Fu style in his temple.   Despite his great knowledge in his style he does not open his mind to the possibility of learning from other disciplines at first but after striking up a friendship with Katsumi Orochi post tournament he appears to want to teach as well as learn at the Shinshinkai Dojo.   ~!He fights Sergei Taktarov in round 1, Mount Toba in round 2, and destroys Orochi Katsumi in round 3. He then makes it to the semi-finals of the Maximum Tournament and is pitted against Baki Hanma where Baki nearly kills him by breaking his neck.  In the "Search of Our Strongest Hero" saga, he has encounters with the British convict Hector Doyle and American convict Dorian. Retsu brings Baki to China to cure his poisoned body and have him fight in a Chinese Tournament. He reappears in Baki: Son of Ogre, during the Pickle saga, having a fight with the prehistoric man and losing it. He then gets his leg eaten by Pickle, as a "gift" for his victory. He later trains Katsumi so that he can become stronger before his fight with Pickle.  Sometime afterward, it appears Retsu wants to take his plans to truly educate others about the Chinese martial arts global, and so he enters a boxing gym seeking strong opponents , the coach asks him to do a strength test by punching a bag with all his strength ,Retsu does so apprehensively and destroys the bag, a few days later at the gym a flash boxing promoter/manager enters the gym and sees Retsu practicing not boxing but a Kung Fu exercise just standing their maintaining his pose for nearly 2 hours, and an idea flashes in the manager's head and he arranges an exhibition match between a former champ and Retsu, during the course of his next few fights it appears Retsu has gained some respect for Western fighters as well as showing them how to absorb damage, hit with absolutely all their strength and use lightning speed, (as well as making millions in the process for these exhibition matches but seemingly completely indifferent towards the money).!~

A karate master and head of the shinshinkai-kan.One of the only people in the world able to stand toe-to-toe with Yujiro. He whips his students into shape by fighting them regularly, and practices all of his karate techniques at least one thousand times daily. A very devoted karate practitioner, and a mentor of Baki's. Also the instructor of Katou and father of Katsumi. He fought Yujiro, who gouged his eye out and killed him. However, Doppo was revived by Kureha. He eventually fights the escaped American convict Dorian in the 'Search of our Strongest Hero' manga series. Dorian manages to cut off Doppo's hand with a strange wire-cutting technique in which he uses a wire blade projected from a lighter. Doppo later avenges this loss when he, Katsumi, and Retsu track Dorian down. Shortly after this however, Dorian escapes from the hospital and uses an explosive that is implanted into his hand to blow off part of Doppo's face.  This however, does not kill him, but leaves many scars on his face.    (Source: Wikipedia)
A clone of the legendary Musashi Miyamoto, reanimated by the dark arts of Mitsunari Tokugawa's sister.

Master of the ancient jujutsu arts used by the samurai soldier-warriors of feudal Japan. Is just over seventy years of age, and has trained since prior to World War II, in the "old days" of the martial arts. His art makes use of the martial arts principle of aiki, which uses the opponents' attacks against him. Manages to make it all the way through to semi-finals in the Maximum Tournament series and battles against Jack Hanma. In his third match with Doppo, Goki is shown to act in an insane manner while fighting. He also states that he's killed many people. He later teams up with Baki to face the Japanese convict Yanagi Ryukou in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' series. He also has a friendly sparring match with Biscuit Oliva and another match with Mohammad Ali Jr. In the Maximum Tournament, he faces Roger Harlon in round 1, and Shinogi Koushou in round 2 before facing Doppo in round 3 and losing to Jack Hammer in round 4. When not fighting, he's quite eccentric (as well as a bit senile) as he lives the day and fears nothing. Although in the series Goki is said to be a master of the old style of jujutsu, and when he fights Doppo it is said that he represents Jujitsu, most Goki's techniques looks like Aikido, and even Goki himself resembles the Aikido Master Gozo Shioda, founder of the Yoshinkan Aikido.

Yūko Maekawa - A 3rd dan, Doppo's son and current prodigy of Shinshinkai karate. ~!He fights Roland Gustof in round 1 defeating him easily before fighting Hanayama Kaoru and fighting a more even round 2 using his sonic fists technique. In round 3 he loses miserably to Retsu Kaioh getting knocked out in 1 punch. Retsu was impressed that Katsumi could take one of his punches. A rematch in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' series is interrupted when the convict Dorian comes into the Shinshinkai building and attacks Katsumi. Katsumi also later trains the convict Doyle in Shinshinkai Karate. In the anime it is revealed that Doppo is actually Katsumi's adoptive father. The final moments of the anime show him washing up at Doppo's home. He has a fight with Pickle which he loses despite his new Mach Punch technique, and as a result he got his right arm torn off and several limbs broken. He is seen in hospital recovering from his wounds shortly after.!~

Leader of the Kurenai racing gangs, he is a street fighter that doesn't seem to feel pain. He fights Hatanaka Kouhei in round 1 where he severely breaks his own arm as a form of intimidation before viciously beating Kouhei. In round 2 he fights Ian McGregor with shadow bonding and nearly defeats the boxer. Shiba wins by breaking both of McGregors hands with his rock hard skull. Though he wins he is unable to continue due to injury. He is replaced By Andre who proceeds to throw him through the ceiling after a disgruntled Shiba confronts him and demands to know why he's being replaced by Andre in the tournament. After recovering from that, he is struck in the throat by Jack Hammer and knocked out. He's last shown (still injured), riding with his gang. Shiba makes a surprise return in the Son of Ogre series. At the request of Hanayama Kaoru, Shiba is to be Baki's training partner for the upcoming fight with Yujiro. Kaoru says Shiba must be Baki's partner because Shiba is weak. Baki is reluctant to fight Shiba at first, but finds a reason of his own when Shiba keeps on attacking him at various times throughout the day.

Motobe Izo is an old Japanese Jujitsu master. He is a calm and pretty gloomy person, who rarely shows any excitement. At one time, he seemed to have more of an obsession with defeating Yujiro Hanma than most martial artists, but he has never shown to be a match for him.

The leader of a mercenary group who fought Baki. He was once a reckless mercenary called Nomura who loved killing. However, after facing the "ultimate fear" when faced with a firing squad during the Ugandan Bush War, he lost his hair and the personality of Gaia manifested from Nomura, as well as gaining supersensory ability. It is said that Gaia is Yujiro's equal in combat. However, when it comes to jungle warfare, he is considered to be the king and he is often called as "Mr.War" and "War god". As a evidence of his ability, he and his mercenary team was hired by the JGSDF as a instructor for non-conventional warfare, and they defeated an entire company of soldiers including a Type 90 Tank in a training battle with ease. As Nomura he is best described as a weakling who acts as a medic for the team. However, when the situation is right and his adrenaline starts pumping, the Gaia personality will manifest itself to fight. He utterly despises Yujiro, stating he is nothing but a thrill seeker that fights for pleasure. He fights Baki and honorably loses to him. When he crossed paths with Yujiro, Gaia told him that Baki is a better warrior than Yujiro can ever be before the two fight (even though he loses miserably). Gaia makes a surprising appearance in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' manga by replacing Jack Hammer during his fight with the Russian convict Sikorsky. He proceeds to defeat Sikorsky with ease, and terrorises Sikorsky into admitting defeat. His three philosophies when fighting are one, take care of your body and give it rest; two, free your body from the control of your mind; and finally, use every part of your surroundings as a weapon. In the current series, he no longer works for the JGSDF, and is seen working as a bodyguard for the new American president.

The older brother of Shinogi, he is very narcissistic and trains to develop the perfect body. He is also a surgical genius able to do surgeries that normally take several hours in only 30 minutes, though he does not have a license. He fights Baki Hanma and is destroyed in combat by him after Baki meets the people that got screwed over by him. Ironically, he is saved by one of his victims when he needed a blood transfusion after his match with Baki. In the tournament, he fights his younger brother Shinogi and though he destroys Shinogi he decides to give up to let his younger brother continue in the tournament. During that match, despite losing his eyesight when Shiogi severed two of his cords, he surgically fixed his nerves during his fight. He serves as tournament medic as the matches go on and tried to stop Jack Hammer from using any steroids only to be beaten by him. Later, he helps Jack Hammer develop new ways of getting stronger without the use of steroids.

__Fighting Style:__ Chinese Kenpo

Kaiou Kaku has shown to have both sociopathic ruthlessness and pride in Chinese Martial Arts and its culture going as far as stabbing three Chinese Martial Arts Association elders in the hand with a needle and then slicing off their limbs with a simple hand chop, and dismissing two current Kaiohs due to "emergency" to replace them for his son and best friend in the name of China and its martial arts to win the Raitai tournament and not lose to foreigners, going as far to even kill the other team so that a Chinese fighter would win the tournament.
~!After his son Shunsei's flash defeat against Baki Hanma, just after he promised to kill him to save the Chinese team's face, Kaku tells him he is not sure if he is really his son and he should drop martial arts forever.!~

The tournament runner and owner of the underground arena. He is an old man of very small stature, possibly even being a dwarf. While not a fighter himself, he is very knowledgeable about the martial arts and can easily point out several fighting techniques, regardless of whether they are obscure or well-known. He has the final say in each and every one of the battles that take place in his arena. While he usually prefers to keep every fight in order, he will sometimes bend the rules if it means amplifying the fight in some way, even going so far as to threaten one of his own doctors with a knife when they tried to stop the fight between Baki and Jack. 

He is close personal friends with Doppo and Igari, as well as acquaintances (though not exactly friendly) with Yujiro. He is one of the few people to ever outsmart Yujiro. When Yujiro attempted to upset the balance of his tournament, he had his snipers, who he had secretly stationed around the arena, to shoot him with enough tranquilizer to put down a blue whale. This gives him the very rare achievement of being the only person who has ever knocked Yujiro unconscious. While it is unknown if Tokugawa was once a fighter himself in his early days, his odd antics and physical appearance make him more likely to be nothing more than an eccentric billionaire who prefers to watch fights instead of participating in them. His namesake is clearly based on Ieyasu Tokugawa and Mitsunari Ishida, the opposing commanders at the Battle of Sekigahara.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title.romaji: Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohantabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car wo Shoukan Shimashita
title.english: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
title.native: 捨てられ聖女の異世界ごはん旅 隠れスキルでキャンピングカーを召喚しました

synonyms: สตรีศักดิ์สิทธิ์ผู้ถูกทอดทิ้ง ออกเดินทางชิมอาหารในต่างโลกด้วยสกิลลับอัญเชิญรถบ้านแคมป์ปิ้ง
Isekai CamPer - I viaggi culinari in un altro mondo della santa rinnegata: Ho evocato un camper grazie a una skill nascosta

node.description: She was summoned to another world, only to get kicked out in a split second. Her hobbies are solo camping, cooking, and TRPGs, but now she's living the ultimate *real-life* RPG dream! The chance to hunt, cook, and eat her own food? It’s absolutely the best! She'll be doing her best as the cook and pack-mule for the adventurer party "Gluttony’s Table"! Oh, and apparently, she is a Saint or something.

She’s a beauty and a member of the "Gluttony Table." Watching her fight using threads is so cool—it practically brings back memories of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) sealed-away "chuunibyou" phase! Plus, she smells amazing and is so soft; getting a tight hug from her makes Rin go "hehehe"... She’s totally best-girl material! It’s also wonderful how head-over-heels in love she is with her husband, [Edo](https://anilist.co/character/398642/Edo). Oh, and she absolutely loves eating delicious food.

He’s the first "Ogre-Dragon" guy [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) met in this other world. He’s a highly skilled adventurer and the leader of the "Gluttony Table." Sure, he’s got a bit of a high "fuel consumption" and looks intimidating, but he’s a gentleman—kind, strong, and handsome to boot! He’s a total feast for the eyes. He’s definitely a favorite of Rin! Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

He’s a magic alchemist and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s cheerful and personable, but he absolutely dotes on his wife, [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/398641/Aria); whenever Aria and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) give each other a tight hug, he shoots her a really intense look... It’s just friendship—pure friendship! Still, seeing how head-over-heels they are for each other is just the best. Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

A winged cat we encountered in a certain dungeon. Apparently, it’s the offspring of a monster known as a... well, whatever it is. But such details don't matter when faced with that fluffiness! It acts a bit haughty, but it’s actually a total cuddle-bug that loves anyone who dotes on it.

She is the female Kobold receptionist at the Adventurers' Guild in the city of Elrage—the home base of the "Gluttony Party." Fluffiness, round two! Yet, despite appearances, she is a seasoned veteran with twenty years of service under her belt; a reliable, attentive, and caring adult woman.

An elf and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s a cleric who uses healing and support magic, though he’s also been known to bash monsters with a mace instead of a bow. There’s a unique kind of nourishment to be found in an elf whose appearance is deceptive—possessing mystical beauty and a fragile air, yet overflowing with raw power! He’s a character you just have to root for. Plus, he loves eating delicious food.

The Adventurer's Guild Master—a burly, rugged guy who looks the part with his muscular build, eyepatch, and the cross-shaped scar on his face. While his words and actions are as boisterous as his appearance suggests, he also possesses a cool head and a thoughtful nature; he’s exactly the kind of person you’d want as a boss. That said, it seems like he can't say no to [Sheila-san](https://anilist.co/character/400913/Sheila), doesn't it?

Watching her fight using threads is so cool—it practically brings back memories of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) sealed-away "chuunibyou" phase! Plus, she smells amazing and is so soft; getting a tight hug from her makes Rin go "hehehe"... She’s totally best-girl material! It’s also wonderful how head-over-heels in love she is with her husband, [Edo](https://anilist.co/character/398642/Edo). Oh, and she absolutely loves eating delicious food.

sampleCharacters.name: Viru
sampleCharacters.description: He’s the first "Ogre-Dragon" guy [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) met in this other world. He’s a highly skilled adventurer and the leader of the "Gluttony Table." Sure, he’s got a bit of a high "fuel consumption" and looks intimidating, but he’s a gentleman—kind, strong, and handsome to boot! He’s a total feast for the eyes. He’s definitely a favorite of Rin! Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

sampleCharacters.name: Edo
sampleCharacters.description: He’s a magic alchemist and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s cheerful and personable, but he absolutely dotes on his wife, [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/398641/Aria); whenever Aria and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) give each other a tight hug, he shoots her a really intense look... It’s just friendship—pure friendship! Still, seeing how head-over-heels they are for each other is just the best. Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

sampleCharacters.name: Gomamiso
sampleCharacters.description: A winged cat we encountered in a certain dungeon. Apparently, it’s the offspring of a monster known as a... well, whatever it is. But such details don't matter when faced with that fluffiness! It acts a bit haughty, but it’s actually a total cuddle-bug that loves anyone who dotes on it.

sampleCharacters.name: Sheila
sampleCharacters.description: She is the female Kobold receptionist at the Adventurers' Guild in the city of Elrage—the home base of the "Gluttony Party." Fluffiness, round two! Yet, despite appearances, she is a seasoned veteran with twenty years of service under her belt; a reliable, attentive, and caring adult woman.

sampleCharacters.name: Xenon
sampleCharacters.description: An elf and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s a cleric who uses healing and support magic, though he’s also been known to bash monsters with a mace instead of a bow. There’s a unique kind of nourishment to be found in an elf whose appearance is deceptive—possessing mystical beauty and a fragile air, yet overflowing with raw power! He’s a character you just have to root for. Plus, he loves eating delicious food.

sampleCharacters.name: Toori
sampleCharacters.description: The Adventurer's Guild Master—a burly, rugged guy who looks the part with his muscular build, eyepatch, and the cross-shaped scar on his face. While his words and actions are as boisterous as his appearance suggests, he also possesses a cool head and a thoughtful nature; he’s exactly the kind of person you’d want as a boss. That said, it seems like he can't say no to [Sheila-san](https://anilist.co/character/400913/Sheila), doesn't it?

node.description: He was an aristocrat who served as the prime minister of a large nation in a certain world, but one day he was suddenly transported to another world. After being transported to that world, he became an adventurer and decided to enjoy life in another world, calling it a "vacation". He has a very calm way of speaking and behaving, and is also endowed with an excellent mind.

Nicknamed "The Blade," he is the strongest adventurer. He has a mean look in his eyes. He is skilled in human combat and monster subjugation. He also has a high ability to sense presence, making his abilities as an adventurer impeccable. Originally, he was a lone wolf who didn't flatter or obey anyone, but after meeting Lizel, he became his partner.

He is an employee of the Adventurer's Guild in the royal capital of Parteda. He rarely expresses emotions and generally remains expressionless at all times. Due to his emotionless appearance and the ice-element magic he uses, adventurers fear him and call him "Absolute Zero." He is adept at anything from desk work to heavy lifting. He is an old friend of [Judge](https://anilist.co/character/380597/Judge).

A snake-like beastman. He is a solo adventurer. He has a charming smile, but contrary to his appearance, he has a very aggressive and violent personality. He has the flexibility and speed of a snake itself, and is skilled in the use of weapons.

A tall man who runs a tool shop in the royal capital of Parteda. He has a timid personality and is reserved with everyone he interacts with. However, he can also make assertive statements at times. He has an excellent eye for appraisal, and sometimes helps appraise labyrinth items and monster materials brought to the Adventurer's Guild.

A middle-aged nobleman who manages the military police, he holds the title of Viscount. He is sociable and can talk to anyone casually, and does not often abuse his power. Furthermore, his refreshing appearance makes him very popular among the townspeople. He is also a "labyrinth item collector," and acquires items of interest through the Adventurer's Guild and auctions.

He is the lord of the commercial city of Marcaid. He is friends with [Insigh](https://anilist.co/character/380601/Insigh). He is extremely busy as he is involved in all economic activities in Marcaid. With a few exceptions, he hides his identity from the people of the territory, so he is almost completely unknown within the territory.

[Judge's](https://anilist.co/character/380597/Judge) grandfather, who runs a trading business based in the commercial city of Marcaid. He is renowned as a major merchant who has a great influence on domestic and international logistics. He is skilled at reading the world and proposing new products, and never misses a business opportunity. He dotes on Judge.

node.description: Tsunagu is reserved, calm, and doesn't express that much emotion, due to the discrimination that beastmen such as him are put through whenever they enter into human cities. Tsunagu is well aware of the fact that Beastmen have been stereotyped as violent and easily provoked, and so Tsunagu attempts to limit himself from expressing too much emotion, especially not anger.

Yukihiro Aida is calm, observant, and remarkably steady compared to the more volatile Beastfolk characters around him. His loyalty is deep and sincere; once he cares about someone, he’s unwaveringly protective.

A cat-species beastman. She is Tsunagi’s childhood friend, and they were raised together like siblings. She loves Tsunagi deeply and initially harbors a strong sense of rivalry toward Mari, but after coming to know Mari’s straightforward nature, she gradually begins to support the two of them and their relationship. She was wary of humans at first, but through her interactions with Mari and Yukihiro, she grows and matures. She loves fashion and is confident in her sense of style.

A friend and classmate of Mari. Her hobby is writing novels, and her dream is to become a novelist. Her parents, who prioritize studying, allowed her to write novels on the condition that she always get first place in tests, but after meeting Tsunagu, she begins to think about how to face her parents and her dreams. Although she is usually cool, she becomes childishly dependent on her childhood friend Ritsuka. Together with Ritsuka, she supports Mari and Tsunagu's romance.

A classmate of Mari and her friends. He is uncomfortable with beastmen living in the same environment as humans and frequently targets Tsunagi with harassment. He hates lies and is willing to be alone if that is what it takes to live honestly and true to himself, making him a principled person in his own way. However, this defiant attitude often leads to misunderstandings from those around him, and at times it can even escalate into trouble.

Mari's friend and classmate. She is often seen with Mari and Ayano, and although she is the smallest of the three, she has a caring nature. She has known Ayano for a particularly long time, and always looks forward to reading the novels she writes. She is like a big sister to everyone, encouraging those who are unsure. She has a lively and energetic demeanor, and her hobby is baking sweets.
Mari's beloved dog. A fluffy, pure white 5-year-old Pomeranian. His special skill is playing frisbee.

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.
__Physical Age:__ 26 (at death)

The eldest son of the Mitsukiya family. A fifth-grader in elementary school. A boy with blonde hair and blue eyes, he looks like a beautiful Caucasian girl. Because he receives hand-me-down feminine clothes in place of his tomboyish older sister, [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212/), he usually dresses in girls' clothes. He is more outgoing and free-spirited than his sister, and consciously uses his cuteness as a weapon to involve those around him, including adults, and act freely. His spiritual power is above average, but not as high as his sister's.

The eldest daughter of the Mitsukiya family. A second-year middle school student. She has short black hair and a boyish appearance. She has an outgoing personality and often acts together with her younger brother, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/382213/). She is courageous and, even upon first meeting [Dara](https://anilist.co/character/382211/), is not intimidated and quickly becomes friendly with her. She possesses remarkable psychic abilities, to the point that Dara is amazed, and is sensitive to spiritual phenomena that ordinary humans cannot perceive.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212/) and [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213/) mother. A middle-aged woman with a voluptuous figure. She closely resembles Hinata in appearance. She has been in charge of managing the forbidden areas and shrines since high school, in place of her father, [Hyougo](https://anilist.co/character/382214/). During her high school years, she was able to perceive [Dara-san](https://anilist.co/character/382211/) and was even saved by her. Because of that experience, she worships Dara-san not as an object of fear, but as a god protecting the cursed objects enshrined in the shrines.

Neighbor to the Misogiya family. She is an introverted, bespectacled otaku girl with a fear of men. She makes a living from home as a freelance developer. She likes [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/382213), and has the ambition to marry him when he becomes an adult, even though he is still in elementary school.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212)'s classmate.

A girl who was in the same kindergarden class as Hinata. She ended up going to a private elementary and middle school, but was teetering on the border of life and death after [Yamatagi Madara](https://anilist.co/character/400573/) forcibly possessed her. She narrowly survived due to the effects of her supernaturally-accelerated spiritual growth. After aging from 12 years to 15 years old during her brief coma, she had a period of rehab, and then returned to school. Her body is now roughly 16 and a half years old, but her mind is still that of a 12 year old. Despite having enough raw spiritual power to be acknowledged by the great demon, her spiritual sense is poor, so she is completely unaware of her situation.
[Hinata's](https://anilist.co/character/382212/) homeroom teacher.
The other half of the serpent god that was once sealed away.
[Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213/) classmate.
The school nurse at [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213/) elementary school.
[Dara](https://anilist.co/character/382211/)'s twin sister.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212) and [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213) grandfather. An elderly man of his age who manages the shrine of [Yamatagi Madara](https://anilist.co/character/382211/). He strictly warns his grandchildren, Hinata and Kaoru, not to approach the forbidden area.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212) and [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213) father. An ophthalmologist. Originally from Australia, he and his family became naturalized Japanese citizens in his childhood and speak fluent Japanese. He met [Chiyo](https://anilist.co/character/382215/) in college, married her, and became [Hyougo](https://anilist.co/character/382214/)'s son-in-law. He has almost no psychic abilities, but he believes in the existence of supernatural phenomena and is cooperative in his duties at the Mitsukiya family home.

[Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213/) homeroom teacher. A middle-aged man with an overweight build and glasses. He gives off the impression of a lecherous teacher who preys on his students, but he's actually in his early 30s and is a genuinely honest person who cares deeply for his students. He enjoys sewing and excels at making cosplay costumes, and he and Kaoru get along well. He makes various costumes for Dara, from shrine maiden outfits to maid outfits, at Kaoru's request.

node.description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.
A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

Yi Huan is a Vice General who serves in Great General Ao Meng's army. In the past, he was a bandit leader with the moniker Yi Huan the Beheader.

His personality is said to be extremely brutal as he has no qualms in killing surrendered soldiers and personally beheaded every person in any city or village he conquered. This is shown in how he sends Wei soldiers, who have been severely tortured, along with bags of eyeballs back to their camp to decrease morale and incite fear.

He always has an arrogant smirk on his face and talks in a crude manner at times. He shows no respect for his foes as he calls Feng Xuan "an old fart" and "trash" before killing him. He is exhibits a sense of humor and sarcasm as in the case when a fellow crew member asked him why he made an unskilled man named Ogiko as 1000-man commander of The Yi Huan army, he replied "Gyahaha cause it's funny obviously."

He also has a cool demeanor and almost never displays any shock no matter how bad the situation is. Yi Huan also shows a very dark side as he toys with Xi Bai Gui by dangling the idea of escape from death if he begged for his life then stabbed him several times after he refused to grovel.

He does exhibits a sense of loyalty exclusive to Ao Meng by holding the rank of Vice General in his army and coming when summoned as demonstrated when Tang Zhang used Ao Meng's name, as he knew that Yi Huan would simply ignore an request for a conversation with him.
The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

One of the 3 great heavens generals of Zhao.

~!He marries [Yin Hai](https://anilist.co/character/132035/Hai-Yin) later on in the series.!~

He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin. She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin. It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers. She remains with Xin after they part ways with Zheng and she cares for their home during some of Xin's early campaigns before heading to strategy academy, where she is taught by Shou Hei Kun. Her expertise result in her eventual appointment as lead strategist of the Hi Shin Unit ~!and later the Hi Shin Army!~. One of the most notable displays of her strategic prowess was during the battle of Koku You Hill.

Chang Ping is one of the Four Pillars of Ryo and the Chancellor of the Right in the Qin court. He is a strategic genius and the Head of Military Affairs under King Zheng Ying of Qin. In the strategist academy, he instructed Mou Ten, Mou Ki, ​and Ten in the ways of strategic warfare.

A merchant who ranked up as Qin's Right Chancellor.   ~!Shortly after he is introduced, it is revealed that he is planning to keep his army in Wei until Zheng Ying dies, then storm Qin's capital of Xianyang, denouncing Jiao Cheng as a tyrant and taking the throne for himself. !~
Ping Wei is one of the squad leaders of the Fei Xin Force. He comes from the same village as Xin, the village of Jouto.
Yuan is a member of the Qin Military and a lieutenant in the Hi Shin Unit.
Ogiko is a 1000-Man Commander and the personal messenger of Great General Kan Ki. He is the leader of the Ogiko Unit.

You Tian is a 100-man Commander in the Qin Military and one of the original members of the Fei Xin Force. 

He was tasked with gathering strong people for Shin's 100-man SquadronConsidered strong enough to be counted as part of the Four Monster Squad. He has trained in the carpentry trade.

One of the squad leaders of the Fei Xin Force.
Ryuu Tou was a General of the Zhao Military forces and one of the Deputies under General Ki Sui, the Lord of the City of Rigan.

Rai Do was ex-bandit from Qin serving in the Kan Ki Army and the leader of Rai Do Clan. He later became a General during the Battle of Eikyuu.
