sampleCharacters.description: Hiroshi is one of Nūbē's most active supporters. He is a transfer student who arrives at Doumori Elementary at the start of the manga, he is at first suspicious of his teacher's exorcism claims, but eventually comes around due to being saved from one spiritual problem after another. Typical of many young shounen leads in manga and anime, he is the courageous, heroic male of the class who is always standing up to fight against any obstacle, whether they be human or yōkai or whether it makes sense or not. His favorite past-time is playing soccer for the school. Unfortunately, Hiroshi's downside is his own stupidity: he has some of the worst grades in Nūbē's class and once even set a record for having a hundred 0s in a row on his tests! This lack of brains both causes him to have outlandish comments on simple ideas and leads him to many of his yōkai problems. He once even wet his pants after a ghost scared him in a restroom.

sampleCharacters.name: Manami Kimura
sampleCharacters.description: Manami is [Katsuya](https://anilist.co/character/8331/Katsuya-Kimura)'s little sister.

sampleCharacters.name: Noriko Nakajima
sampleCharacters.description: She is the sweet, cute, and possibly most "normal" girl in class 5-3 compared to some of her classmates. Unlike the others, Noriko never tries to look for trouble, but trouble constantly does seem to find her. Originally a "background character" early on (mostly found alongside her best friend Shizuka), "Noro-chan" slowly becomes one of the more prominent members of the class and a consistent target for spiritual activity. Miki in particular has a beef against her: With her cute face, shoulder-length pink hair and the second-largest bust in the class, the buxom blonde always gets upset whenever Noriko steals the spotlight away from her (consistently saying Noro-chan no kuse ni!!, or "That Noro-chan!") While she does seem docile and quiet, Noriko does occasionally unleash a wilder and more playful side (but it takes certain yōkai phenomenon to do so). She's also known as a bookworm and a rather clever tactician; once she was the key to resolving a very creepy case that involved the ghost of the school library and a series of kidnappings related to the ghost's favorite book, which incidentally was the same as Noriko's.

sampleCharacters.name: Katsuya Kimura
sampleCharacters.description: The "juvenile delinquent" of the class, Katsuya Kimura (Kimura Katsuya 木村克也) acts much worse than he really is towards Nūbē and his other classmates. At the start of the series, Katsuya is consistently portrayed as a loner, either due to being misunderstood by his classmates, his own cowardice or from his delinquent behaviors such as smoking or stealing charity for a good cause. But as the series goes on, he slowly comes to grips with himself and joins in with Nūbē and his friends where he is one of the main members of the class. Katsuya is a huge pervert towards sexy females, an attribute that gets him into a huge idolation of Miki. (though she sees treats him like her dog) He also finds himself consistently with the worst grades in class alongside both Hiroshi and Makoto. But while he is a coward and a bad seed, he is amazingly also a loving, caring and protective big brother towards his little sister, Manami. Source - Wikipedia

sampleCharacters.name: Makoto Kurita
sampleCharacters.description: While the same age as all of his classmates, Makoto Kurita (Kurita Makoto 栗田まこと) is perhaps the youngest in heart and spirit of class 5-3. At the start of the series, this bowl-haired boy finds himself the most emotional of the students, running and screaming away from any scary phenomenon. But with Nūbē's guidance and the assistance of his friends, he slowly learns to face his fears and grow up in certain ways. One of Makoto's greatest strengths is his kind and friendly nature, allowing him to try and remain cheerful in the face of both human and yōkai threats. However, he remains the most childlike of Nūbē's students, both in stature (though he is small, he is constantly hoping for the day he will "grow up") and his love of kiddy past-times like keeping pets or watching sentai series. (His most favorite being Chou Kiken Sentai Kakukaku Ranger which is a slight parody in name of the series Ninja Sentai Kaku Ranger, but translates as Extremely Dangerous Sentai Nuclear Ranger) While he also receives horrible grades like Hiroshi and Katsuya, he actually puts in effort to try to improve himself in any way possible. His name and the model for his character design are both inspired from the Kazuo Umezu manga series Makoto-chan. Wikipedia

sampleCharacters.name: Shizuka Kikuchi
sampleCharacters.description: Another of the more prominent "background characters", Shizuka Kikuchi (Kikuchi Shizuka 菊地静) was actually introduced as a one-joke character. When Nūbē does a class on the Ichimatsu Doll, he ends up using a cute girl with long black hair (Shizuka) as part of a joke to get rid of a possession. Outside this early joke, this female typically is found in the background, either doing things alongside the rest of the class or hanging out usually with her best friend Noriko. But while she seems merely innocent in the background, a later chapter reveals that it allows her to easily tattle on her classmates to Nūbē, due to a strong sense of justice that she holds that she puts above her friends which nearly gets her in trouble with a dangerous team of yōkai. (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Zashiki-warashi
sampleCharacters.description: A small child like Yokai that followed Nube around. It can also give luck to people just by being around her.

sampleCharacters.name: Akira Yamaguchi
sampleCharacters.description: Akira Yamaguchi (Yamaguchi Akira 山口晶), one of the smartest students in Nūbē's class, is also the one that goes through a slight character change as the series goes on. At the start of the series, Akira is merely a bright, but slightly unlucky boy who tries his best but can never achieve what he's capable of. The source of this bad luck was a near-death experience where he went to the Sanzu River, where a yōkai consistently stops anyone that tries to complete their tasks. After Nūbē exorcises this spirit, Akira finds a bit more luck, but remains a more generic character. But later in the series, Akira's modest personality changes towards that of being the "mad scientist" of the class, consistently using technology to bridge the gap between humans and yōkai and showing off in order to do so. Originally, Akira was paired alongside Hiroshi, Kyoko, Makoto and Miki as part of the main set of students whom allies with Nūbē. But because of Akira's earlier "plain" personality, he fell out of favor over more dynamic characters like Katsuya. Regardless, he does remain a semi-major character throughout the whole manga run. Like Miki, Akira's name is based on the main male lead in Go Nagai's Devilman. (Source: Wikipedia)

sampleCharacters.name: Shuichi Shirato
sampleCharacters.description: The richest and most snobbish member of Nueno's class, Shuichi Shirato is the son of the owners of one of the finest restaurants in Doumori. Because of this, this "classy" boy consistently taunts Nuenos personal tastes, both in cuisine and in his lack of material possessions. But while there are many times the teacher can't stand his arrogant attitude, Nueno consistently finds a way to help him whenever he finds himself caught in a youkai situation. In a slight deviation from his teacher and classmates, Shuichi finds interest in more scientific means of the supernatural such as aliens and cryptozoology, trying to show there are things other than youkai out there, but consistently finding Nueno back to assist him. Still, Shuuichi isn't an evil person per se; he also sincerely loves animals, to the point of being willing to give up his life to stop an angry youkai that once was a puppy.

node.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm

He's the longest-serving part-time worker at Spirytus, having been with the company since it was founded. He's 29 years old. As [Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) senior, he strictly teaches his juniors how to do their jobs. He uses all kinds of means and tools, but his favorite tool is the whip. His favorite hobby is reading. His favorite food is Sushi and he dislikes oysters.

__Height:__ 178 cm

Part-time worker at Spirytus. Skilled and sociable. He's good at any job and has moved from one part-time job to another, but he seems to find his job of "torture" rewarding. His favorite tool is the "hammer." He doesn't have hobbies, and insteads gambles to kill time. His favorite food is katsudon and he dislikes broccoli.

__Height:__ 201 cm

Spirytus's new part-timer. He tried to avoid interacting with people as much as possible, but started this part-time job to learn about society. For a certain reason, he always hides his face. His favorite tool is the “watering can.” His hobby is solo camping. He enjoys eating hamburg steak and dislikes liver.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Spirytus's new part-timer. A novelist with boundless curiosity. Petite with an adorable face, but when he gets absorbed in his work, he sometimes reveals an unexpected side. His favorite tool is the “Cat's Claw.” His hobby is playing FPS games. He enjoys chocolate and he dislikes dandan noodles.

__Height:__ 181 cm

He's the talented president of Spirytus, the industry's top white-collar company. Before founding his company, he and [Shiu](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) worked as torturers. He cross-dresses because it's his "destiny" to do so due to his sheer beauty. His hobby is driving. He enjoys eating horse sashimi and dislikes onions.

__Height:__ 178 cm

A Spirytus employee. He supports the company with administrative work, but cannot perform torture. Was taken in by [Hela](https://anilist.co/character/0373295/Hela) as a child and has been in love with him ever since. He doesn't get along with [Cero](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero). Photography is his personal hobby. His favorite food is omelette rice and he dislikes celery.

__Height:__ 115cm

[Shiu's](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) beloved daughter. The older twin sister, responsible. Attends elementary school. Loves the color black because it's the color of her beloved Papa and [Nero](https://anilist.co/character/382480/Nero). She like strawberries and dislikes tomatoes.

__Height:__ 115 cm

[Shiu's](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) beloved daughter. The younger twin sister with a laid-back personality. Attends elementary school. She loves white because it's the color of her beloved dad and [Reu](https://anilist.co/character/382474/Reu). Her favorite food is strawberries and she dislikes carrots.

__Height:__ 184cm

The “doctor” who handles unforeseen incidents during torture. He appears unmotivated, yet holds firm convictions about his work. He shares a complicated history with Spirytus.

__Height:__ 145cm

A "cleaner" contracted to clean the torture chamber. She hides her face with a gas mask while working. She is a big fan of [Mikke's](https://anilist.co/character/373037/Mikke) novels.

__Height:__ 182 cm

[Hugh's](https://anilist.co/character/373038/Hugh) cheerful friend from high school who attends the same university. He cares deeply for his friends and often encourages Hugh when he's feeling down.

__Height:__ 167 cm

The energetic owner of the torture device shop “dolor”. She demands not only practicality but also artistic merit in her torture devices. With a fierce business sense, she'll stop at nothing to make her shop thrive. She enjoys strawberry daifuku and dislikes fatty meat.

__Height:__ 164cm

“The Hitwoman,” [Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) ex-girlfriend. She met Cero when they were both hosts. A beautiful woman with a straightforward personality, she still has feelings for Cero even after they broke up.

__Height:__ 183cm

A 31-year-old who runs a shadowy network for disposing of criminals and handles post-torture cleanup. He's been involved with Spirytus for a long time, yet remains shrouded in mystery. What matters most to him is “money and trust.”

__Height:__ 158 cm

A nurse working at Izua Hospital. She communicates with anyone other than [Izua](https://anilist.co/character/393208/Izua), whom she trusts, through her stuffed bear Amumu. She's an unusual girl, but she's skilled at her job.

__Height:__ 174cm

[Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) younger brother. A 17-year-old high school student. He has loved his older brother since childhood and has a brocon complex, but recently Cero has been working all the time and hasn't come home, which makes him feel lonely. He is a member of the library committee and soccer club.

node.description: The only daughter of the noble House of Reinweiß. She has a bright and affectionate personality, with keen intuition that allows her to quickly notice people's secrets. She's also an extreme vampire otaku, and when she gets switched on, her rampage leaves her companions utterly dumbfounded.

name.native: アルネ・ノインテーター

node.description: A vampire who practices detective work under the belief that “solving mysteries is meant to be enjoyed.” Originally the “most fearsome” being with nine hearts, he has now lost several of them and switches between the forms of a boy and an adult depending on the situation.

A necromancer who is always calm and collected, with a constant expression and whose thoughts are difficult to read. However, she is unusually kind to [Lynn](https://anilist.co/character/378164/Lynn-Reinwei). She has the ability to control corpses and throw her sewn-together arms like a rocket punch, making her fighting ability extremely high.

He lives with his father, who runs the Hartmann Detective Agency in Blumstadt. He loves comics featuring monsters and heroes, but also possesses his father's keen observational skills. His catchphrase is, “The case is happening in the real world!”
